sentence: No fas ina mi biznis!

sentence: Di fuud stil at, kom mek wi nyam.

sentence: Wier yu at ina di son.

sentence: Nof kloud de ina di skai, rien a kom.

sentence: Aanti, mi kyan elp yu wid di pat?

sentence: Mi granmada wash kloz ina di yaad evri maanin.

sentence: A mi granfaada tiich mi fi swim.

sentence: Di biebi no waan sliip, im a krai di huol nait.

sentence: Mi huol badi taiyad afta di wok.

sentence: Tek kier a yu badi, yu onggl get wan.

sentence: Mi ed no gud tide, mi kyaan tingk strait.

sentence: Mi ies taiyad fram luk pan di fuon aal die.

sentence: No taak wid yu mout ful.
translation: Don't talk with your mouth full.

sentence: Di dakta luk ina di biebi ier.

sentence: Mi sista a kom yaad fi du im ier.
translation: My sister is coming home to do her hair.

sentence: Wi waak go a skuul pan wi fut evri die.
translation: We walk to school on foot every day.

sentence: Mi fut a kil mi, mi hafi sidong.
translation: My legs are killing me, I have to sit down.

sentence: Mi beli ongri, mek wi go nyam.
translation: I'm hungry, let's go and eat.

sentence: Wan glaas a bush ti gud fi yu beli.
translation: A glass of bush tea is good for your stomach.

sentence: Im aat gud, im aalwiez a elp di uol piipl dem.

sentence: Wen mi ier di nyuuz, mi aat jomp.

sentence: Di dag ron gaan wid mi shuuz.

sentence: Duon mek di dag kom ina di ous!
translation: Don't let the dog come in the house!

sentence: Di pus nyam-op di fish we mi lef pan di tiebl.

translation: My cat is afraid of water.

sentence: Di kou dem a waak pan di ruod agen.

sentence: Di likl bwai a kya di kou go a di riva.

translation: The bed is too small for three children to sleep on.

sentence: Di tiebl brok wen di pat faal pan it.

sentence: Gi di uol uman wan chier fi sidong.

sentence: Mi granfaada aalwiez sidong pan di siem chier anda di tri.
translation: My grandfather always sits in the same chair under the tree.

sentence: Wier yu bes kloz fi di pati.

sentence: Di kloz dem stil de pan di lain an rien a faal.
translation: The clothes are still on the line and it's raining.

sentence: Yu fi wier yu gud shuuz go a chorch.
translation: You should wear your good shoes to church.

sentence: Mi hafi wash mi shuuz afta mi waak chuu di bush.
translation: I have to wash my shoes after I walk through the bush.

sentence: Put di buk dem ina yu bag.
translation: Put the books in your bag.

sentence: Di bag ful a mango, mi kyaan kya it.
translation: The bag is full of mangoes, I can't carry it.

sentence: Mi likl sista ried im buk evri nait.
translation: My little sister reads her book every night.

sentence: Mi kyaan fain di buk we di tiicha gi mi.
translation: I can't find the book the teacher gave me.

sentence: Gi mi wan pen, mek mi rait dong di niem.
translation: Give me a pen, let me write down the name.

sentence: Mi faada ried di piepa evri mawnin.
translation: My father reads the newspaper every morning.

sentence: Di tiicha gi evri pikni wan piepa fi di tes.
translation: The teacher gave every child a sheet of paper for the test.

sentence: Kaal mi pan di fuon wen yu riich a yaad.
translation: Call me on the phone when you get home.

sentence: Uu a kaal yu pan di fuon suo liet?
translation: Who's calling you on the phone so late?

sentence: Aks di tiicha ef yu no andastan.
translation: Ask the teacher if you don't understand.

sentence: Mi waan bikom wan tiicha wen mi grou big.
translation: I want to become a teacher when I grow up.

sentence: Kaal di dakta, di biebi sik.
translation: Call the doctor, the baby is sick.

sentence: Di dakta se mi fi res fi wan huol wiik.
translation: The doctor said I should rest for a whole week.

sentence: Aks di nors we di dakta de.
translation: Ask the nurse where the doctor is.

sentence: Di nors dem wok haad chuu di huol nait.
translation: The nurses work hard through the whole night.

sentence: Wen di polis kom, evribadi ron.
translation: When the police came, everybody ran.

sentence: Di polis stap di kyaar pan di ruod.
translation: The police stopped the car on the road.

sentence: Evri satdi mawnin di faama kya im banana kom dong a maakit.
translation: Every Saturday morning the farmer brings his bananas down to the market.

sentence: Mi granfaada did a faama op ina di kontri.
translation: My grandfather was a farmer up in the country.

sentence: Di fishaman kech nof fish yeside.
translation: The fisherman caught plenty of fish yesterday.

sentence: Mi onkl a wan fishaman, im gaan a sii fram mawnin.
translation: My uncle is a fisherman; he's been out at sea since morning.

sentence: Mi neba gi mi som akii fram im tri.
translation: My neighbour gave me some ackee from his tree.

sentence: Di neba dem a labrish bout di nyuu piipl pan di striit.
translation: The neighbours are gossiping about the new people on the street.

sentence: Di huol famili a kom ova fi Sondi dina.
translation: The whole family is coming over for Sunday dinner.

sentence: Im famili liv a Kingston, bot im baan a kontri.
translation: His family lives in Kingston, but he was born in the country.

sentence: Mi mada aalwiez se mi fi respek mi eldas.
translation: My mother always says I must respect my elders.

sentence: Di biebi a krai fi im mada.
translation: The baby is crying for its mother.

sentence: Mi faada tiich mi ou fi jraiv.
translation: My father taught me how to drive.

sentence: Wen mi faada kom fram wok, wi aal sidong an nyam.
translation: When my father comes home from work, we all sit down and eat.

sentence: Di guot a nyam di flowa dem ina mi yaad.
translation: The goat is eating the flowers in my yard.

sentence: A fi uu guot dis?
translation: Whose goat is this?

sentence: Mi mada kech di fowl fi Sondi dina.
translation: My mother caught the chicken for Sunday dinner.

sentence: Wen di rien staat faal, di fowl dem ron go anda di ous.
translation: When the rain started falling, the chickens ran under the house.

sentence: Wan likl bod tel mi se yu a lef.
translation: A little bird told me you're leaving.

sentence: Wan bod flai chuu di winda.
translation: A bird flew in through the window.

sentence: Mi granfaada tel wi wan stori bout wan laiyan.
translation: My grandfather told us a story about a lion.

sentence: A onggl ina buk mi si laiyan.
translation: It's only in books that I've seen a lion.

sentence: Di mangguus tiif di fowl eg dem.
translation: The mongoose stole the hen's eggs.

sentence: Mi si wan mangguus ron chuu di bush yeside.
translation: I saw a mongoose run through the bush yesterday.

sentence: Di krab dem kom out afta di rien faal.
translation: The crabs come out after the rain falls.

sentence: Umoch di krab dem kaas?
translation: How much do the crabs cost?

sentence: Wan waas flai ina di ruum an evribadi ron out.
translation: A wasp flew into the room and everybody ran out.

sentence: Mi kyaan sliip fi di maskita.
translation: I can't sleep because of the mosquitoes.

sentence: Evri iivnin wen di son go dong, di maskita dem kom out.
translation: Every evening when the sun goes down, the mosquitoes come out.

sentence: Wen di kou ded, di jankro dem kom fram aal ova.
translation: When the cow died, the John Crows came from all over.

sentence: Di uol man kaal im wan jankro.
translation: The old man called him a vulture.

sentence: Di smadi we tel yu dat a wan liad.
translation: The person who told you that is a liar.

sentence: Nobadi no laik wan liad.
translation: Nobody likes a liar.

sentence: Di polis kech di tiif a di shap.
translation: The police caught the thief at the shop.

sentence: Smadi tiif mi baisikl las wiik.
translation: Somebody stole my bicycle last week.

sentence: Mi faada jraiv di bos go a toun evri die.
translation: My father drives the bus to town every day.

sentence: Duon jraiv tuu fas pan dis ruod!
translation: Don't drive too fast on this road!

sentence: Mi granfaada ried di nyuuz evri die.
translation: My grandfather reads the news every day.

sentence: Di likl bwai kyaan ried yet, bot im a laan.
translation: The little boy can't read yet, but he's learning.

sentence: Di tiicha tel wi fi rait wan stori bout wi famili.
translation: The teacher told us to write a story about our family.

sentence: Yu rait, mi shuda did lisn.
translation: You're right, I should have listened.

sentence: Unu lisn gud, mi a go se it wan taim.
translation: All of you listen carefully, I'm going to say it once.

sentence: Im neva lisn tu im mada.
translation: He didn't listen to his mother.

sentence: Di kwaia a sing a chorch pan Sondi.
translation: The choir is singing at church on Sunday.

sentence: Uu tiich yu fi sing?
translation: Who taught you to sing?

sentence: Mi granmada stil kyan daans beta dan mi.
translation: My grandmother can still dance better than me.

sentence: Evribadi staat laaf wen im faal dong.
translation: Everybody started laughing when he fell down.

sentence: Wen mi granmada ded, evribadi krai.
translation: When my grandmother died, everybody cried.

sentence: Duon krai, mi wi get wan oda wan fi yu.
translation: Don't cry, I'll get another one for you.

sentence: Wen di biebi si im mada, im staat smail.
translation: When the baby saw his mother, he started to smile.

sentence: Smail fi di pikcha, man!
translation: Smile for the picture, man!

sentence: Mi uop di rien stap bifuo maakit die.
translation: I hope the rain stops before market day.

sentence: Wi a uop se im get di wok a di nyuu shap.
translation: We're hoping he gets the job at the new shop.

sentence: Mi lov ou yu kuk di rais an piiz.
translation: I love how you cook the rice and peas.

sentence: Gi di pikni som lov.
translation: Give the child some love.

sentence: Mi iet fi waak a skuul ina di at son.
translation: I hate walking to school in the hot sun.

sentence: Mi bai iet mango a maakit.
translation: I bought eight mangoes at the market.

sentence: Di pikni dem fried fi go a di riva.
translation: The children are afraid to go to the river.

sentence: Mi did fried wen mi did likl.
translation: I was scared when I was little.

sentence: Mek shuor yu kom bak bifuo nait.
translation: Make sure you come back before night.

sentence: Mi shuor se mi lef mi buk pan di tiebl.
translation: I'm sure I left my book on the table.

sentence: Yu tink di shuuz we im bai a maakit riil?
translation: Do you think the shoes he bought at the market are real?

sentence: Im a wan riil gud faama.
translation: He's a really good farmer.

sentence: Mi ier se im gaan a farin, dat chuu?
translation: I heard he's gone abroad — is that true?

sentence: Wi waak chuu di bush.
translation: We walked through the bush.

sentence: Sari, mi tek di rang bos.
translation: Sorry, I took the wrong bus.

sentence: Wa rang wid yu tide?
translation: What's wrong with you today?

sentence: Di bos lef widout wi.
translation: The bus left without us.

sentence: Di shap de pan yu lef, afta di chorch.
translation: The shop is on your left, past the church.

sentence: Wen rien a faal, wi stie a yaad.
translation: When it rains, we stay at home.

sentence: Umoch die yu ago stie?
translation: How many days are you staying?

sentence: Mi granmada liv a kontri.
translation: My grandmother lives in the country.

sentence: Di uol uman we liv neks duo nais bad.
translation: The old lady who lives next door is really nice.

sentence: Mi granfaada ded bifuo mi baan.
translation: My grandfather died before I was born.

sentence: Mi fuon ded an mi kyaan kaal nobadi.
translation: My phone is dead and I can't call anybody.

sentence: Mi mada baan an grou a Kingston.
translation: My mother was born and raised in Kingston.

sentence: Di biebi baan yeside mawnin.
translation: The baby was born yesterday morning.

sentence: Mi faada grou banana a yaad.
translation: My father grows bananas at home.

sentence: Wen yu grou big, wa yu waan du?
translation: When you grow up, what do you want to do?

sentence: Mi a laan fi kuk rais an piiz.
translation: I'm learning to cook rice and peas.

sentence: Di tiicha laan wi fi ried.
translation: The teacher taught us to read.

sentence: Mi aanti tiich a di skuul dong di ruod.
translation: My aunt teaches at the school down the road.

sentence: Uu tiich yu fi jraiv?
translation: Who taught you to drive?

sentence: Mi no memba im niem.
translation: I don't remember his name.

sentence: Memba fi bring di bag wen yu kom bak.
translation: Remember to bring the bag when you come back.

sentence: Mi figet fi bai di bred a maakit.
translation: I forgot to buy the bread at the market.

sentence: Mi naa figet dat die.
translation: I'll never forget that day.

sentence: Mi no andastan wa di tiicha a se.
translation: I don't understand what the teacher is saying.

sentence: Taak slou, mek mi andastan.
translation: Talk slowly so I can understand.

sentence: Mi no biliiv notn we im se.
translation: I don't believe anything he says.

sentence: Yu biliiv se dem ago kom bak fi wi?
translation: Do you believe they'll come back for us?

sentence: Di bwai dem kom bak fram futbaal wid dem kloz doti.
translation: The boys came back from football with their clothes dirty.

sentence: Di mango dem faal dong pan di doti.
translation: The mangoes fell down on the ground.

sentence: No wies yu moni pan dat.
translation: Don't waste your money on that.

sentence: Mi wies tuu die a luk fi di kii.
translation: I wasted two days looking for the key.

sentence: Mi granmada stil yuuz di siem uol pat fi kuk rais.
translation: My grandmother still uses the same old pot to cook rice.

sentence: Wa yu yuuz fi wash di pliet dem?
translation: What do you use to wash the plates?

sentence: Yu no niid fi bring notn.
translation: You don't need to bring anything.

sentence: Di pikni dem niid nyuu shuuz fi skuul.
translation: The children need new shoes for school.

sentence: Mi laik di sang we dem a plie.
translation: I like the song they're playing.

sentence: Di likl bwai luk laik im faada.
translation: The little boy looks like his father.

translation: The door was open, but there was nobody in the house.

sentence: Di shap shet aredi, suo wi hafi kom bak tumaro.
translation: The shop is already shut, so we have to come back tomorrow.

sentence: No figet fi shet di winda dem bifuo di rien kom.
translation: Don't forget to shut the windows before the rain comes.

sentence: Wa yu a go wier a di pati?
translation: What are you going to wear to the party?

sentence: Im wier di siem uol shuuz evri die go a wok.
translation: He wears the same old shoes to work every day.

sentence: Mi kyaan swim, bot mi laik go a di sii.
translation: I can't swim, but I like going to the sea.

sentence: Di bwai dem gaan a di riva go swim.
translation: The boys have gone to the river to swim.

sentence: Wen im ier di nyuuz, im jomp op an staat laaf.
translation: When he heard the news, he jumped up and started laughing.

sentence: Di pus jomp op pan di tiebl.
translation: The cat jumped up on the table.

sentence: Tan de, mi a kom bak.
translation: Stay there, I'm coming back.

sentence: Di uol man tan op a di giet a taak wid im neba.
translation: The old man stood at the gate talking with his neighbour.

sentence: Kom sidong yaso, mek wi taak.
translation: Come sit down right here, let's talk.

sentence: Wen mi riich a yaad, mi sidong an res mi fut.
translation: When I get home, I sit down and rest my feet.

sentence: Mi hafi gedop a faiv aklak evri mawnin fi kech di bos.
translation: I have to get up at five o'clock every morning to catch the bus.

sentence: Im no waan gedop fram di bed tide.
translation: He doesn't want to get out of bed today.

sentence: Di myuuzik fram di dansaal wiek op di huol yaad.

sentence: Wiek mi a siks, mi hafi go a wok.

sentence: Di pikni dem bied ina di riva evri iivnin.

translation: Go and bathe before you sit down at the table.

translation: He married a girl from the country.

sentence: Mi breda no marid yet, im se im no riedi.
translation: My brother isn't married yet, he says he's not ready.

sentence: Uu a di uona a dis kyaar?

sentence: Wi hafi aks di uona bifuo wi muuv di tiebl dem.
translation: We have to ask the owner before we move the tables.

sentence: Chrai di akii, yu wi laik it.
translation: Try the ackee — you'll like it.

sentence: Mi chrai fi fain di kii, bot mi kyaan si it.
translation: I tried to find the key, but I can't see it.

sentence: Di kyaar no waan staat dis mawnin.
translation: The car won't start this morning.

sentence: Mek wi staat di wok bifuo di son get tuu at.
translation: Let's start the work before the sun gets too hot.

sentence: Di bos stap rait a di chorch giet fi pik op di pikni dem.

sentence: Di rien no stap faal fram maanin.
translation: The rain hasn't stopped falling since morning.

sentence: Wen di konsert finish, wi wi waak go a yaad.
translation: When the concert finishes, we'll walk home.

sentence: Kyan yu elp mi wid dis bag?
translation: Can you help me with this bag?

sentence: Mi neba elp mi mada kya di baskit fram maakit.
translation: My neighbour helped my mother carry the basket from the market.

sentence: Gud-op, mi bwai! Yu pas di tes.
translation: Well done, my boy! You passed the test.

sentence: Di pikni dem daans wel, suo wi aal se gud-op.
translation: The children danced well, so we all said well done.

sentence: Tank yu, mi wi si yu tumaro.

sentence: Mi mada se fi tank yu fi di mango dem.
translation: My mother says to thank you for the mangoes.

sentence: Di likl bwai a beg moni a di maakit giet.

sentence: Beg yu wan glaas a wata.

sentence: Mi sari fi ier bout yu granmada.
translation: I'm sorry to hear about your grandmother.

sentence: Mi mada aalwiez waari wen mi kom yaad liet.

sentence: No waari, evriting wi aarait.
translation: Don't worry — everything will be alright.

sentence: Wi kil di fowl an mi granmada kuk it fi Sondi dina.
translation: We killed the chicken and my grandmother cooked it for Sunday dinner.

sentence: Di maskita dem a kil mi evri nait.
translation: The mosquitoes are killing me every night.

sentence: Di tuu bwai dem a fait ova wan futbaal.

sentence: No mek dem fait ina di yaad.
translation: Don't let them fight in the yard.

sentence: Kech di baal, no mek it faal!
translation: Catch the ball, don't let it fall!

sentence: Di polis kech di tiif we tiif mi fuon.
translation: The police caught the thief who stole my phone.

sentence: Im trow di baal ova di fens.
translation: He threw the ball over the fence.

sentence: Mi trow di uol bred out gi di fowl dem.
translation: I threw the old bread out for the chickens.

sentence: Wi hafi pul di baisikl out a di bush.
translation: We have to pull the bicycle out of the bush.

sentence: No pul mi an, man!
translation: Don't pull my hand, man!

sentence: Di man dem a push di bos op di ruod.
translation: The men are pushing the bus up the road.

sentence: No push di pikni dem, dem wi faal.
translation: Don't push the children — they'll fall.

sentence: Put di pliet dem pan di tiebl bifuo dina.
translation: Put the plates on the table before dinner.

sentence: Mi kot mi finga wen mi did a kuk.
translation: I cut my finger while I was cooking.

sentence: Uu kot di flowa dem?
translation: Who cut the flowers?

sentence: Mi mada a wash di kloz ina di yaad.
translation: My mother is washing the clothes in the yard.

sentence: Wash yu an bifuo yu iit.
translation: Wash your hands before you eat.

sentence: Mi hafi kliin di ruum bifuo mi mada riich.
translation: I have to clean the room before my mother gets here.

sentence: Di wata ina di riva kliin an kuol.
translation: The water in the river is clean and cold.

sentence: A no yu biznis wa mi du wid mi moni.

sentence: Im open wan likl biznis a di maakit di oda die.

sentence: Wa di prablem wid di kyaar?

sentence: Mi no nuo di ansa, mi ago aks di tiicha.

sentence: Im neva gi mi no ansa yet.
translation: He still hasn't given me an answer.

sentence: Mi waan fi aks yu wan kwestyan.
translation: I want to ask you a question.

sentence: Di tiicha kyaan ansa evri kwestyan we di pikni dem aks.
translation: The teacher can't answer every question the children ask.

sentence: Mi no andastan dat wod, wa it miin?
translation: I don't understand that word, what does it mean?

sentence: Im gi mi im wod se im a kom.
translation: He gave me his word that he's coming.

sentence: Mi kyaan memba di gyal niem, bot mi nuo im mada.
translation: I can't remember the girl's name, but I know her mother.

sentence: Wa niem dem gi di biebi?
translation: What name did they give the baby?

sentence: Wen dat sang plie, evribadi staat daans.
translation: When that song plays, everybody starts to dance.

sentence: Mi granmada sing wan uol sang wen im a kuk dina.
translation: My grandmother sings an old song while she's cooking dinner.

sentence: Mi kyaan wok widout myuuzik a plie.
translation: I can't work without music playing.

sentence: Dem plie rege myuuzik aal die a di shap.
translation: They play reggae music all day at the shop.

sentence: Mi ier di ridim bifuo mi ier di wod dem.
translation: I hear the rhythm before I hear the words.

sentence: Wi a go a dansaal Satdi nait.
translation: We're going to the dancehall on Saturday night.

sentence: Di myuuzik from di dansaal wiek mi op a chrii aklak.
translation: The music from the dancehall woke me up at three o'clock.

sentence: Mi granfaada onggl lisn to uol rege.
translation: My grandfather only listens to old reggae.

sentence: Wen di rege staat plie, mi fut kyaan tan stil.
translation: When the reggae starts playing, my feet can't keep still.

sentence: Di Anansi stori dem mek di pikni laaf.
translation: The Anansi stories make the children laugh.

sentence: Mi no waan ier no stori bout uu du it.
translation: I don't want to hear any story about who did it.

sentence: Yu ier di nyuuz bout Miss Mary?
translation: Did you hear the news about Miss Mary?

sentence: Di nyuuz se di rien ago faal aal wiik.
translation: The news says the rain is going to fall all week.

sentence: Tel mi di chrut nou.
translation: Tell me the truth now.

sentence: A chrut mi a tel yu, mi neva tek it.
translation: It's the truth I'm telling you, I never took it.

sentence: Dat a wan big lai!
translation: That's a big lie!

sentence: Duon lai to mi, mi nuo we yu did de.
translation: Don't lie to me, I know where you were.

sentence: Yu tink dis a joke?
translation: You think this is a joke?

sentence: Mi onkl tel di siem joke evri Sondi.
translation: My uncle tells the same joke every Sunday.

sentence: Di huol striit kom out a mi aanti pati.
translation: The whole street came out to my aunt's party.

sentence: Yu a kom a di pati tumaro?
translation: Are you coming to the party tomorrow?

sentence: Wan gud fren wort muor dan moni.
translation: A good friend is worth more than money.

sentence: Mi fren dem elp mi wash di kyaar.
translation: My friends helped me wash the car.

sentence: Dat man tek mi fi im enimi.
translation: That man treats me like his enemy.

sentence: Mi no waan no enimi, mi onggl waan liv gud wid evribadi.
translation: I don't want any enemies, I only want to live well with everybody.

sentence: Di piipl dem a taak bout it aal ova toun.
translation: People are talking about it all over town.

sentence: Di piipl we liv neks duo nais, man.
translation: The people who live next door are nice, man.

sentence: Mi mada sen mi go a shap fi bai bred an shuga.
translation: My mother sent me to the shop to buy bread and sugar.

sentence: Evri mawnin mi tek di bos go a wok bifuo siks aklak.
translation: Every morning I take the bus to work before six o'clock.

sentence: Nobadi no nuo mi laik mi granmada, bikaa a im gruo mi.
translation: Nobody knows me the way my grandmother does — she's the one who raised me.

sentence: Yu lef yu buk dem pan di bed, an nou yu liet fi skuul.
translation: You left your books on the bed, and now you're late for school.

sentence: Ef yu riich a di maakit bifuo mi, bai som akii an saalfish.
translation: If you get to the market before me, buy some ackee and saltfish.

sentence: Mi respek yu bikaa yu neva ron gaan wen mi did niid elp.
translation: I respect you because you never ran off when I needed help.

sentence: Evri Sondi wi kuk rais an piiz fi di huol famili.
translation: Every Sunday we cook rice and peas for the whole family.

sentence: Di tiicha aks wi fi bring wi buk dem kom a skuul tumaro.
translation: The teacher asked us to bring our books to school tomorrow.

sentence: Duon waari bout notn, wi wi kom bak fi yu bifuo nait.
translation: Don't worry about anything — we'll come back for you before nightfall.

sentence: Pikni, unu mos wash unu an dem bifuo unu sidong fi iit.
translation: Children, you all have to wash your hands before you sit down to eat.

sentence: Waa-gwaan, unu a kom a di dansaal wid wi, ar unu stie a yaad?
translation: What's up — are you all coming to the dance with us, or are you staying home?

sentence: Mi tank unu fi elp mi muuv di tiebl dem outa di rien.
translation: Thank you all for helping me move the tables out of the rain.

sentence: Di pat did at bad, suo mi put i dong pan di tiebl kwik.
translation: The pot was really hot, so I put it down on the table quickly.

sentence: Wen yu don ried di buk, bring i kom gi mi a wok.
translation: When you've finished reading the book, bring it to me at work.

sentence: Mi neva laik di sang fos taim, bot nou i swiit mi bad.
translation: I didn't like the song at first, but now it really gets to me.

sentence: Mi breda a wan tiicha, an im wok a di skuul dong di ruod.
translation: My brother is a teacher, and he works at the school down the road.

sentence: Di rien a faal aad, an mi mada a kuk sinting at fi wi.
translation: The rain is coming down hard, and my mother is cooking something hot for us.

sentence: Mi beks bikaa a mi wan a wash di pliet dem evri nait.
translation: I'm vexed because I'm the only one washing the plates every night.

sentence: Di kii dem de pan di tiebl anda di buk we yu lef.
translation: The keys are on the table under the book you left.

sentence: Nof piipl de a di maakit satdi mawnin, suo riich de-so orli.
translation: There are plenty of people at the market on Saturday morning, so get there early.

sentence: Duon fraitn, mi wi de ya wid yu di huol nait.
translation: Don't be frightened — I'll be right here with you the whole night.

sentence: Shet di winda dem kwik, di rien a faal pan di bed.
translation: Shut the windows quickly — the rain is falling on the bed.

sentence: Di bos lef di skuul giet bifuo di pikni dem riich.
translation: The bus left the school gate before the children got there.

sentence: Mi tink di fuud a di nyuu shap beta dan di maakit fuud.
translation: I think the food at the new shop is better than the market food.

sentence: Mi ago kuk di chikin nou bifuo di lait go out agen.
translation: I'm going to cook the chicken now before the power goes out again.

sentence: Di tiicha se im ago gi wi wan big tes neks wiik.
translation: The teacher says he's going to give us a big test next week.

sentence: Wen mi granmada si wi a im giet satdi mawnin, im ago krai.
translation: When my grandmother sees us at her gate on Saturday morning, she's going to cry.

sentence: Gwaan go a yu bed nou, yu ago liet fi skuul tumaro.
translation: Go on to bed now — you'll be late for school tomorrow.

sentence: Wa a gwaan dong a di maakit? Nof piipl a ron kom.
translation: What's going on down at the market? Plenty of people are running this way.

sentence: Afta im mada ded, im gwaan tek kier a di huol famili.
translation: After his mother died, he carried on taking care of the whole family.

sentence: Evri Satdi mawnin mi go a maakit fi bai fish fi Sondi dina.
translation: Every Saturday morning I go to the market to buy fish for Sunday dinner.

sentence: Di bos gaan aredi, suo wi hafi waak go a wok.
translation: The bus has already left, so we have to walk to work.

sentence: Mi taiyad fi go a chorch evri Sondi mawnin, bot mi mada naa lisn.
translation: I'm tired of going to church every Sunday morning, but my mother won't hear of it.

sentence: Luk anda di bed fi mi shuuz, di taksi de a di giet.
translation: Look under the bed for my shoes — the taxi is at the gate.

sentence: Mi a luk fi wan nyuu wok, bikaa di shap a go shet dong.
translation: I'm looking for a new job, because the shop is going to close down.

sentence: Yu luk taiyad dis mawnin; yu neva sliip gud las nait?
translation: You look tired this morning; didn't you sleep well last night?

sentence: Bai di taim mi riich a di ruod, di bos gaan lef mi.
translation: By the time I got out to the road, the bus had gone and left me.

sentence: Mi breda gaan a Merika ten yier nou, im no kom bak yet.
translation: My brother has been gone to America ten years now, and he still hasn't come back.

sentence: Aal mi moni gaan pan skuul fi di pikni dem, bot mi no sari.
translation: All my money has gone on schooling for the children, but I'm not sorry.

sentence: Mi mada sen mi go a shap fi bai wan dazn eg.
translation: My mother sent me down to the shop to buy a dozen eggs.

sentence: Yu fi riich a di miitn bifuo siks, duon kom liet agen.
translation: You're supposed to get to the meeting before six — don't come late again.

sentence: A no fi yu buk dat, a fi mi sista, gi it bak.
translation: That's not your book, it belongs to my sister — give it back.

sentence: Mi neva av nof moni fi di bos, suo mi waak go a yaad.
translation: I didn't have enough money for the bus, so I walked home.

sentence: Mi len mi fren som moni las wiik, bot im naa ansa im fuon.
translation: I lent my friend some money last week, but now he won't answer his phone.

sentence: Mi faada aalwiez se moni no gruo pan tri, suo duon wies it.
translation: My father always says money doesn't grow on trees, so don't waste it.

sentence: Evri mawnin mi gedop a faiv aklak fi kech di fos bos a toun.
translation: Every morning I get up at five o'clock to catch the first bus to town.

sentence: Wi av wan miitn tumaro mawnin, suo duon riich liet agen.
translation: We have a meeting tomorrow morning, so don't turn up late again.

sentence: Sondi mawnin swiit mi, bikaa nobadi no hafi ron go a wok.
translation: Sunday morning is sweet to me, because nobody has to rush off to work.

sentence: Put di baskit anda di tiebl bifuo di pus nyam op di fish.
translation: Put the basket under the table before the cat eats up the fish.

sentence: Di bwai dem a plie futbaal anda di lait pan di ruod evri iivnin.
translation: The boys play football under the street light out on the road every evening.

sentence: Afta mi granmada tel di dopi stori, mi haid anda di kova huol nait.
translation: After my grandmother told that duppy story, I hid under the covers the whole night.

sentence: Kom ya kwik, di rais a bon pan di faiya.
translation: Come here quick — the rice is burning on the fire.

sentence: Mi de ya sins siks aklak a wiet pan di dakta.
translation: I've been here since six o'clock waiting on the doctor.

sentence: Afta faiv yier a farin, mi api fi kom bak ya wid mi famili.
translation: After five years abroad, I'm happy to be back here with my family.

sentence: Wa yu a kuk ina di pat, di huol yaad smel swiit?
translation: What are you cooking in that pot? The whole yard smells delicious.

sentence: Aks di uman a di giet wa taim di maakit shet pan Satdi.
translation: Ask the woman at the gate what time the market closes on Saturday.

sentence: Wa mi si a di riva yeside mek mi aat jomp.
translation: What I saw down at the river yesterday made my heart jump.

sentence: Wai yu lef di duo open aal nait wen maskita dem a bait?
translation: Why did you leave the door open all night when the mosquitoes are biting?

sentence: Nobadi kyaan tel mi wai di bos neva kom dis mawnin.
translation: Nobody can tell me why the bus didn't come this morning.

sentence: Wai yu a waari bout wa dem se, wen dem no nuo yu?
translation: Why are you worrying about what they say, when they don't even know you?

sentence: Evribadi ina di yaad kom out wen dem smel di chikin a frai.
translation: Everybody in the yard came outside when they smelled the chicken frying.

sentence: Evribadi tel mi se di rien ago stap, bot i stil a faal.
translation: Everybody told me the rain was going to stop, but it's still coming down.

sentence: Nobadi neva lef notn ina di pat fi mi wen mi riich yaad.
translation: Nobody left anything in the pot for me by the time I got home.

sentence: Nobadi a di bos stap kuda tel mi wen di neks bos a kom.
translation: Nobody at the bus stop could tell me when the next bus was coming.

sentence: Nobadi no waan tel di chrut, an dat a wa mek mi beks.
translation: Nobody wants to tell the truth, and that's what has me angry.

sentence: Wan-wan mango did lef pan di tri, so mi tek dem gi mi aanti.
translation: Only a few mangoes were left on the tree, so I took them to my aunt.

sentence: Di faama dem riich a maakit wan-wan, so di plies neva ful til iivnin.
translation: The farmers arrived at the market one by one, so the place didn't fill up until evening.

sentence: Mi granmada aalwiez se wan-wan koko ful baskit, so mi siev likl moni.
translation: My grandmother always says the basket fills one coco at a time, so I put a little money aside.

sentence: Mi bai tuu poun a rais fi di wiik, bot i finish aredi.
translation: I bought two pounds of rice for the week, but it's finished already.

sentence: Tuu bwai fram mi skuul a plie kriket a di paak evri satdi.
translation: Two boys from my school play cricket in the park every Saturday.

sentence: Di myuuzik a di dansaal did tuu loud, so mi gaan yaad orli.
translation: The music at the dancehall was too loud, so I went home early.

sentence: Mi mada kuk chrii pat a fuud fi di huol famili pan Sondi.
translation: My mother cooked three pots of food for the whole family on Sunday.

sentence: Chrii man fram di distrik kom elp mi bild di fens laas wiik.
translation: Three men from the district came and helped me build the fence last week.

sentence: Mi liv a farin chrii yier nou, an mi stil mis mi granmada fuud.
translation: I've been living abroad three years now, and I still miss my grandmother's cooking.

sentence: Fuor a wi shier wan ruum, so mi neva get no sliip laas nait.
translation: Four of us share one room, so I didn't get any sleep last night.

sentence: Di bos lef a fuor aklak, so wi hafi pak di baskit dem kwik.
translation: The bus leaves at four o'clock, so we have to pack the baskets quickly.

sentence: Mi tel di man fuor taim aredi, bot im stil naa lisn.
translation: I've told the man four times already, and he still won't listen.

sentence: Di mango tri ina wi yaad gi faiv baskit a frut dis yier.
translation: The mango tree in our yard gave five baskets of fruit this year.

sentence: Mi hafi wiek op a faiv aklak fi kech di fos bos a toun.
translation: I have to get up at five o'clock to catch the first bus to town.

sentence: Faiv a mi bes fren muuv a farin, an mi mis dem bad.
translation: Five of my closest friends moved abroad, and I miss them badly.

sentence: Mi hafi kuk siks dompling bikaa di pikni dem ongri afta skuul.
translation: I have to cook six dumplings because the children are hungry after school.

sentence: Siks a wi skwiiz ina di taksi, an di jraiva stil tek muor.
translation: Six of us squeezed into the taxi, and the driver still picked up more.

sentence: Mi wok siks die evri wiik, an mi taiyad fi chuu.
translation: I work six days every week, and I'm truly worn out.

sentence: Sevn a wi did sidong roun di tiebl an nyam aal di puding.
translation: Seven of us sat around the table and ate all the pudding.

sentence: Di fishaman dem lef di biich a sevn an neva kom bak til nait.
translation: The fishermen left the beach at seven and didn't come back until nightfall.

sentence: Mi wiet sevn wiik fi di ansa, an mi staat fi waari nou.
translation: I waited seven weeks for the answer, and now I'm starting to worry.

sentence: Mi granmada av nain granpikni, an dem aal kaal im Mama.
translation: My grandmother has nine grandchildren, and every one of them calls her Mama.

sentence: Di shap open a nain aklak, bot di lain did lang aredi.
translation: The shop opened at nine o'clock, but the line was already long.

sentence: Wi plie domino til nain aklak, an mi neva waan go yaad.
translation: We played dominoes until nine o'clock, and I didn't want to go home.

sentence: Mi granmada kuk wan gud pat a rais an piiz fi Sondi dina.
translation: My grandmother cooked a good pot of rice and peas for Sunday dinner.

sentence: Di nyuu tiicha suo gud dat aal di pikni dem waan go a skuul.
translation: The new teacher is so good that all the children want to go to school.

sentence: Mi did tink se di konsert wuda bad, bot it did gud.
translation: I thought the concert was going to be terrible, but it turned out good.

sentence: Mi put tuu moch pepa ina di chikin, an nou mi mout a bon.
translation: I put too much pepper in the chicken, and now my mouth is burning.

sentence: Wen mi go a maakit, mi aalwiez bai pepa fram di siem uman.
translation: When I go to the market, I always buy peppers from the same woman.

sentence: Mi granfaada se fuud widout pepa no wort di taim fi kuk.
translation: My grandfather says food without pepper isn't worth the time it takes to cook.

sentence: Evri mawnin mi granmada mek bush ti bifuo di huol yaad wiek.
translation: Every morning my grandmother makes bush tea before the whole household wakes up.

sentence: Afta wi don plaant, di faama shier ti wid evribadi anda di tri.
translation: After we finished planting, the farmer shared tea with everyone under the tree.

sentence: Mi kyaan sliip ef mi no drink wan kop a ti bifuo bed.
translation: I can't sleep unless I have a cup of tea before bed.

sentence: Di bred kaas siks onjred dala nou, bot mi onggl av chrii onjred.
translation: Bread costs six hundred dollars now, but I've only got three hundred.

sentence: Di taksi jraiva se im kyaan tek les dan tuu onjred dala.
translation: The route-taxi driver says he can't take less than two hundred dollars.

sentence: Mi wuda gi mi las dala fi si mi pikni finish skuul.
translation: I'd give my last dollar to see my child finish school.

sentence: Wash yu an dem gud bifuo yu tach di fuud pan di tiebl.
translation: Wash your hands properly before you touch the food on the table.

sentence: Di faama kot im an wid di kotlas, suo im gaan a dakta.
translation: The farmer cut his hand with the machete, so he's gone off to the doctor.

sentence: Mi granmada uol mi an tait, den im se im no fried fi ded.
translation: My grandmother held my hand tight, then said she wasn't afraid to die.

sentence: Mi bai di rang shuuz a maakit, an nou dem tuu tait.
translation: I bought the wrong shoes at the market, and now they're too tight.

sentence: Di tiicha se mi ansa rang, bot mi buk se di siem ting.
translation: The teacher says my answer is wrong, but my book says the same thing.

sentence: Mi did nuo se sinting rang wen nobadi neva ansa di duo.
translation: I knew something was wrong when nobody answered the door.

sentence: Smadi lef di giet open an aal di guot dem gaan.
translation: Somebody left the gate open and all the goats have wandered off.

sentence: Wi niid smadi we kyan jraiv di bos go a maakit pan Satdi.
translation: We need somebody who can drive the bus to the market on Saturday.

sentence: Ef smadi taak bad bout yu, no ansa dem, jos gwaan wid yu biznis.
translation: If somebody talks badly about you, don't answer them, just get on with your business.

sentence: Mi luk ina di pat, bot notn no lef fi dina.
translation: I looked in the pot, but there's nothing left for dinner.

sentence: Notn no sel a di shap tide, an di uona a waari.
translation: Nothing has sold at the shop today, and the owner is worried.

sentence: Im du notn wen mi beg im fi elp, jos waak pas.
translation: He did nothing when I begged him for help, he just walked on past.

sentence: Sinting a muuv anda di bed, an di pus a luk pan it.
translation: Something is moving under the bed, and the cat is watching it.

sentence: Di tiicha waan tel yu sinting bifuo yu lef di skuul yaad.
translation: The teacher wants to tell you something before you leave the school yard.

sentence: Mi did waan se sinting, bot mi mout kudn open ina di miitn.
translation: I wanted to say something, but I couldn't get my mouth open in the meeting.

sentence: Wen di lait gaan las nait, evriting ina di ous ton daak.
translation: When the power went last night, everything in the house went dark.

sentence: Di rien mash op evriting we wi did av fi sel a maakit.
translation: The rain ruined everything we had to sell at the market.

sentence: Mi no waan moni, evriting mi niid de yaso ina dis yaad.
translation: I don't want money — everything I need is right here in this yard.

sentence: Mi hafi wash ten pliet afta di huol famili nyam Sondi dina.
translation: I have to wash ten plates after the whole family eats Sunday dinner.

sentence: Di tiicha gi wi ten kwestyan fi di tes, bot mi kudn ansa tuu.
translation: The teacher gave us ten questions for the test, but I couldn't answer two of them.

sentence: Mi beg di man fi len mi ten dala, an im laaf afta mi.
translation: I asked the man to lend me ten dollars, and he just laughed at me.

sentence: Mi gi di faama wan onjred dala fi chrii big mango a di maakit.
translation: I gave the farmer a hundred dollars for three big mangoes at the market.

sentence: Wan onjred piipl kom a di konsert, an di chorch did ful op.
translation: A hundred people came to the concert, and the church was packed.

sentence: Mi tel yu wan onjred taim aredi fi shet di giet, man!
translation: I've told you a hundred times already to shut the gate, man!

sentence: Di taksi man aks mi tuu touzn dala fi kya mi go a toun.
translation: The taxi man asked me for two thousand dollars to take me into town.

sentence: Di faama sel faiv touzn dala wort a banana a di maakit pan Satdi.
translation: The farmer sold five thousand dollars' worth of bananas at the market on Saturday.

sentence: Mi wuda gi wan touzn dala fi si mi granmada wan muor taim.
translation: I would give a thousand dollars just to see my grandmother one more time.

sentence: Di fos rien staat faal afta mi put di kloz pan di lain.
translation: The first rain started falling right after I put the clothes on the line.

sentence: Dis a di fos taim mi ier di likl gyal sing a chorch.
translation: This is the first time I've heard the little girl sing at church.

sentence: Mi beks bad bikaa dem aalwiez mek di bwai dem plie fos.
translation: I'm really vexed because they always let the boys play first.

sentence: Mi granmada kuk di las tuu eg fi mi bifuo mi go a skuul.
translation: My grandmother cooked the last two eggs for me before I went to school.

sentence: Di las bos gaan aredi, so wi hafi waak go a yaad.
translation: The last bus has already gone, so we have to walk home.

sentence: Dat a di las taim mi len im mi baisikl, bikaa im brok it.
translation: That's the last time I lend him my bicycle, because he broke it.

sentence: Wi a go kil di fowl neks Sondi wen di huol famili kom.
translation: We're going to kill the chicken next Sunday when the whole family comes.

sentence: Di tiicha se di neks tes aad, so wi fi ried di huol buk.
translation: The teacher says the next test is hard, so we ought to read the whole book.

sentence: Neks taim yu waan tek mi buk, aks mi fos, yu ier mi?
translation: Next time you want to take my book, ask me first — you hear me?

sentence: Wan shuuz de anda di bed, bot mi kyaan fain di oda wan.
translation: One shoe is under the bed, but I can't find the other one.

sentence: Di oda bwai dem a plie futbaal, bot mi hafi ried mi buk.
translation: The other boys are playing football, but I have to read my book.

sentence: Mi no laik ou di oda neba dem a labrish bout mi famili biznis.
translation: I don't like the way the other neighbours gossip about my family's business.

sentence: Mi an mi bes fren baan di siem die, so wi shier wan pati.
translation: My best friend and I were born on the same day, so we share one party.

sentence: Aal a wi a du di siem wok, bot im get muor moni.
translation: All of us are doing the same work, but he gets more money.

sentence: Mi api fi si se dem stil plie rege ina di siem uol dansaal.
translation: I'm happy to see that they still play reggae in the same old dancehall.

sentence: Mi mada kuk sinting difrant tide, a no di siem uol rais an piiz.
translation: My mother cooked something different today — not the same old rice and peas.

sentence: Di nyuu tiicha difrant fram di uol wan; im mek di pikni dem laaf.
translation: The new teacher is different from the old one; he makes the children laugh.

sentence: Toun an kontri a tuu difrant plies, bot mi laik di kontri beta.
translation: Town and country are two different places, but I like the country better.

sentence: Di shap did onggl av wan bred lef, so mi bai it kwik.
translation: The shop only had one loaf of bread left, so I bought it quickly.

sentence: Onggl chrii piipl kom a di miitn, so wi lef an go a yaad.
translation: Only three people came to the meeting, so we left and went home.

sentence: Mi no beks wid yu, mi onggl waan yu tel mi di chrut.
translation: I'm not angry with you; I only want you to tell me the truth.

sentence: Di lait gaan agen las nait, an wi sidong ina di daak til maanin.
translation: The power went out again last night, and we sat in the dark until morning.

sentence: Di bos pas mi stap agen dis maanin, so mi riich a wok liet.
translation: The bus went past my stop again this morning, so I got to work late.

sentence: Mi taiyad fi tel yu di siem ting agen an agen evri die.
translation: I'm tired of telling you the same thing over and over again every day.

sentence: Mi granmada aalwiez kuk tuu much fuud, an nobadi kyan finish it.
translation: My grandmother always cooks too much food, and nobody can finish it.

sentence: Di tiicha aalwiez aks mi fos, bikaa mi sidong a di frant.
translation: The teacher always asks me first, because I sit at the front.

sentence: Yu aalwiez riich liet, an dat a wa mek mi beks wid yu.
translation: You always turn up late, and that's what makes me angry with you.

sentence: Somtaim di wata lak aaf, so wi kech rien ina wan big bakit.
translation: Sometimes the water gets shut off, so we catch rain in a big bucket.

sentence: Somtaim di bos no kom at aal, so mi hafi waak a wok.
translation: Sometimes the bus doesn't come at all, so I have to walk to work.

sentence: Mi mis mi granmada yaad somtaim, an mi jos sidong an baal.
translation: Sometimes I miss my grandmother's house, and I just sit down and cry.

sentence: Mi torn di huol ous opsaid dong, bot di kii dem de nowe.
translation: I turned the whole house upside down, but the keys are nowhere to be found.

sentence: Wi jraiv roun di toun fi wan our an fain nowe fi paak.
translation: We drove around town for an hour and found nowhere to park.

sentence: Dis chat naa go nowe, so mek wi jos drap it rait ya.
translation: This conversation is going nowhere, so let's just drop it right here.

sentence: Afta di rien, moskita de evriwe roun di ous a nait.
translation: After the rain, there are mosquitoes everywhere around the house at night.

sentence: Mi luk evriwe a di maakit fi jeli kokonat, bot nobadi naa sel it.
translation: I looked everywhere in the market for jelly coconut, but nobody is selling any.

sentence: Mi fiil se piipl a wach mi evriwe mi go ina dis likl distrik.
translation: I feel like people are watching me everywhere I go in this little district.

sentence: Put muor wata ina di pat, bikaa di rais a bon aredi.
translation: Put more water in the pot, because the rice is already burning.

sentence: Dem gi mi muor moni dis mont, bot di wok get haada tuu.
translation: They gave me more money this month, but the work got harder too.

sentence: Mi waan muor taim wid mi pikni dem, bot di wok neva don.
translation: I want more time with my children, but the work is never finished.

sentence: Muos a di mango pan di tri red aredi, so pik dem tide.
translation: Most of the mangoes on the tree are ripe already, so pick them today.

sentence: Muos die mi taiyad, bot mi stil get op an kuk brekfos.
translation: Most days I'm worn out, but I still get up and cook breakfast.

sentence: Mi fiil beta nou dat di feva drap an mi kyan nyam.
translation: I feel better now that the fever has broken and I can eat.

sentence: Di nyuu tiicha shuo wi di wok beta dan di wan bifuo im.
translation: The new teacher explains the work better than the one before him.

sentence: Mi did tink se ting dem wuda beta afta wi muuv a toun.
translation: I thought things would be better after we moved to town.

sentence: Mi mada kip di bes chier fi mi granfaada wen im kom vizit.
translation: My mother keeps the best chair for my grandfather when he comes to visit.

sentence: Dem gi Delroy di bes prais fi im yam a di maakit tide.
translation: They gave Delroy the best price for his yams at the market today.

sentence: Di bes ting mi eva du a muuv bak kom a kontri.
translation: The best thing I ever did was move back to the country.

sentence: Di liik ina di ruuf get wosa evri taim rien faal haad.
translation: The leak in the roof gets worse every time it rains hard.

sentence: Di ruod get wosa afta di big rien, so no bos naa ron tide.
translation: The road got worse after the heavy rain, so no buses are running today.

sentence: Wa mek it wosa, im neva iivn se sari afta aal dat.
translation: What makes it worse is that he never even said sorry after all that.

sentence: Di wos rien fi di huol wiik faal las nait pan di zink ruuf.
translation: The worst rain of the whole week came down on the zinc roof last night.

sentence: Mondi mawnin a di wos taim fi kech di bos go a toun.
translation: Monday morning is the worst time to catch the bus into town.

sentence: Di wos paat a di huol ting a se im no sari fi it.
translation: The worst part of the whole business is that he isn't sorry about it.

sentence: Di mango fram kontri swiita dan di wan dem we dem sel a toun.
translation: The mangoes from the country are sweeter than the ones they sell in town.

sentence: Mi mek muor moni a di maakit dan mi did mek a di shap.
translation: I make more money at the market than I made at the shop.

sentence: Mi wuda ruoda tel di chrut nou dan mek mi mada fain out laata.
translation: I'd rather tell the truth now than have my mother find out later.

sentence: Mi kuk di rais an piiz aredi, bot di chikin no don yet.
translation: I've already cooked the rice and peas, but the chicken isn't done yet.

sentence: Mi wiet a di bos stap fram siks aklak, bot no bos neva kom.
translation: I waited at the bus stop from six o'clock, but no bus ever came.

sentence: Di wok haad an di moni likl, bot mi lov di piipl dem.
translation: The work is hard and the pay is small, but I love the people there.

sentence: Yu a wash di kloz tide ar yu a lef it fi Satdi?
translation: Are you washing the clothes today or are you leaving it for Saturday?

sentence: Di uman a di maakit aks mi ef mi waan akii ar saalfish tide.
translation: The woman at the market asked me whether I wanted ackee or saltfish today.

sentence: Yu a mi fren ar yu a mi enimi? Mi no nuo agen.
translation: Are you my friend or my enemy? I don't know any more.

sentence: Di lait gaan aal nait bikaa wan big tri faal pan di lain.
translation: The power was out all night because a big tree fell on the line.

sentence: Mi kyaan kom a di miitn bikaa mi hafi kya mi granmada a dakta.
translation: I can't come to the meeting because I have to take my grandmother to the doctor.

sentence: Mi neva go bak a dat shap bikaa im taak bad tu mi mada.
translation: I never went back to that shop because he spoke rudely to my mother.

sentence: Ef yu no shet di giet, di fowl dem wi kom nyam di rais.
translation: If you don't shut the gate, the chickens will come and eat the rice.

sentence: Ef di tiicha aks fi mi, tel im se mi gaan a dakta.
translation: If the teacher asks for me, tell her I've gone to the doctor.

sentence: Ef mi did av di moni, mi wuda sen im go a hai skuul.
translation: If I had the money, I would send him to high school.

sentence: Aldo di ous likl, di huol famili fain wan plies fi sliip.
translation: Although the house is small, the whole family found somewhere to sleep.

sentence: Aldo di shap shet aredi, di uman sel mi wan bred chuu di winda.
translation: Although the shop had already closed, the woman sold me a loaf through the window.

sentence: Mi stil memba di sang aldo mi neva ier it fram mi did likl.
translation: I still remember that song although I haven't heard it since I was little.

sentence: Di rien staat faal, suo wi ron go tek in di kloz.
translation: The rain started falling, so we ran out to take in the clothes.

sentence: Nobadi neva ton op fi wok tide, suo mi wash aal di pliet dem.
translation: Nobody turned up for work today, so I washed all the plates.

sentence: Mi taiyad fi beg im, suo mi lef im fi du wa im waan.
translation: I'm tired of pleading with him, so I've left him to do what he wants.

sentence: Yes, mi shet di giet aredi, yu no hafi aks mi agen.
translation: Yes, I've already shut the gate, you don't have to ask me again.

sentence: Yes man, di wok don, yu kyan kom fi di kii tumaro mawnin.
translation: Yes man, the work is finished, you can come for the key tomorrow morning.

sentence: Yes, a mi brok di pliet, bot mi neva miin fi du it.
translation: Yes, I'm the one who broke the plate, but I didn't mean to.

sentence: Iiya, kom elp mi kya dis bag go a di kyaar.
translation: Hey, come and help me carry this bag out to the car.

sentence: Wa gwaan, iiya? Mi no si yu fram di konsert las wiik.
translation: Hi, how are things? I haven't seen you since the concert last week.

sentence: Iiya, no beks wid im, di bwai a onggl chrai fi elp.
translation: Hey, don't be angry with him, the boy is only trying to help.

sentence: Waa-gwaan, Miss Mary? Mi no si yu a chorch fram las Sondi.
translation: What's up, Miss Mary? I haven't seen you at church since last Sunday.

sentence: Di bwai dem a di shap griit mi wid waa-gwaan wen mi pas.
translation: The boys outside the shop greet me with a what's-up every time I go by.

sentence: Waa-gwaan wid yu tide? Yu no taak to nobadi fram mawnin.
translation: What's going on with you today? You haven't spoken to anybody since this morning.

sentence: Mi mada kaal mi evri Sondi, an mi aalwiez tel im se mi-de-ya.
translation: My mother phones me every Sunday, and I always tell her I'm doing all right.

sentence: Waa-gwaan, breda? Mi-de-ya, mi a tan op a di shap fi bred.
translation: What's up, brother? I'm here, standing outside the shop waiting on bread.

sentence: Taim aad an mi brok, bot wen dem aks mi, mi se mi-de-ya.
translation: Times are hard and I'm broke, but when they ask me, I say I'm getting by.

sentence: Lef di pliet dem pan di tiebl, mi wi wash dem laata.
translation: Leave the plates on the table, I'll wash them later.

sentence: Di dakta bizi nou, im wi si yu laata dis iivnin.
translation: The doctor is busy now; he'll see you later this evening.

sentence: Evri wiik im se laata, bot laata neva kom wid mi moni.
translation: Every week he says later, but later never turns up with my money.

sentence: Rien ago faal suun, suo ron go tek dong di kloz dem.
translation: Rain is going to fall soon, so run and take the clothes down.

sentence: Di las bos ago lef suun, suo mek wi ron go kech it.
translation: The last bus is leaving soon, so let's run and catch it.

sentence: Mi granmada sik, bot di dakta se im ago get beta suun.
translation: My grandmother is ill, but the doctor says she'll get better soon.

sentence: Mi wash aal di kloz aredi, suo sidong an res yu fut.
translation: I've already washed all the clothes, so sit down and rest your feet.

sentence: Wen mi riich a di maakit, dem sel out di bes mango aredi.
translation: By the time I reached the market, they had already sold off the best mangoes.

sentence: Mi tel yu aredi se mi no waan go, bot yu no lisn.
translation: I already told you I don't want to go, but you don't listen.

sentence: A ten aklak nou an di pikni dem stil naa sliip.
translation: It's ten o'clock now and the children still aren't going to sleep.

sentence: Mi de a di shap fram siks aklak an mi stil no finish.
translation: I've been at the shop since six o'clock and I still haven't finished.

sentence: Mi granfaada ded, bot im uol chier stil de a di winda.
translation: My grandfather is gone, but his old chair is still there by the window.

sentence: Put dong di baskit yaso, no ova de-so a di duo.
translation: Put the basket down right here, not over there by the door.

sentence: Tan op yaso a di giet, mi ago kaal di taksi fi yu.
translation: Wait right here at the gate; I'll call the taxi for you.

sentence: Mi baan yaso, mi grou yaso, an mi naa lef dis yaad.
translation: I was born right here, I grew up right here, and I'm not leaving this yard.

sentence: Baksaid! Di pus nyam-op di huol fish we did de pan di tiebl.
translation: Wow! The cat ate up the whole fish that was sitting on the table.

sentence: Baksaid! Di bos lef mi an nou mi ago liet fi wok agen.
translation: Good grief! The bus left me and now I'll be late for work again.

sentence: Baksaid, man! Mi neva nuo se yu kuda ron suo fas.
translation: Wow, man! I never knew you could run that fast.

sentence: Raatid! Di rien faal suo aad it nak dong di huol banana tri.
translation: My goodness! The rain fell so hard it knocked the whole banana tree down.

sentence: Raatid, Miss Mary! Yu kuk nof fuud fi di huol striit nyam.
translation: My word, Miss Mary! You've cooked enough food to feed the whole street.

sentence: A raatid mi se wen dem tel mi umoch di kyaar kaas.
translation: All I could say was 'rahtid' when they told me how much the car cost.

sentence: Mi granmada aalwiez se wi blesd fi av fuud pan di tiebl.
translation: My grandmother always says we're blessed to have food on the table.

sentence: Di faama se im blesd bikaa di rien faal pan im banana.
translation: The farmer says he's blessed because the rain fell on his bananas.

sentence: Mi brok, bot mi av mi famili an mi wok, suo mi blesd.
translation: I'm broke, but I have my family and my work, so I'm blessed.

sentence: Mi granmada uoltaim a kuk rais an piiz pan Sondi mawnin.
translation: My grandmother is always cooking rice and peas on a Sunday morning.

sentence: Di tiicha uoltaim a tel wi se wi mos ried evri nait.
translation: The teacher is forever telling us we have to read every night.

sentence: Di neba dem uoltaim a labrish bout mi famili, an dat beks mi.
translation: The neighbours are always gossiping about my family, and that makes me angry.

sentence: Di likl bwai chrik im sista an nyam aal di mango dem.
translation: The little boy tricked his sister and ate every one of the mangoes.

sentence: Di man we sel fish a maakit chrik mi wid di moni.
translation: The man who sells fish at the market cheated me over the money.

sentence: Duon mek nobadi chrik yu wid swiit taak bout kwik dala.
translation: Don't let anybody fool you with sweet talk about quick money.

sentence: Put dong di ting dem pan di tiebl bifuo yu go a skuul.
translation: Put your things down on the table before you leave for school.

sentence: Di uman a di maakit sel nof ting, fram saalfish tu piepa.
translation: The woman at the market sells all sorts of things, from saltfish to paper.

sentence: Di ting we beks mi muos a se im neva se sari.
translation: The thing that angered me most is that he never said sorry.

sentence: Duon mek di pikni fuul yu, im nuo we di moni de.
translation: Don't let the child fool you — he knows exactly where the money is.

sentence: Di man dem a toun tink se wi fuul bikaa wi kom fram kontri.
translation: The men in town think we're fools because we come from the country.

sentence: Mi did luk fuul wen mi kaal di rang niem a di pati.
translation: I looked like a fool when I called the wrong name at the party.

sentence: Mi wudn lef mi pikni a yaad wid smadi we mi no nuo.
translation: I wouldn't leave my child at home with somebody I don't know.

sentence: Mi wudn tek dat wok fi suo likl moni, aldo mi niid it.
translation: I wouldn't take that job for so little money, even though I need it.

sentence: Ef im did tel mi di chrut, mi wudn beks suo bad.
translation: If he had told me the truth, I wouldn't be this angry.

sentence: Di lait gaan las nait, suo mi kudn finish kuk di dina.
translation: The power went out last night, so I couldn't finish cooking dinner.

sentence: Mi did waan kom a di miitn, bot mi kudn get no bos.
translation: I wanted to come to the meeting, but I couldn't get a bus.

sentence: Mi kudn sliip las nait, di daag dem a baak a di giet.
translation: I couldn't sleep last night — the dogs were barking at the gate.

sentence: Evri taim rien faal aad, di lait gaan an mi fuon ded.
translation: Every time the rain comes down hard, the power goes and my phone dies.

sentence: Di man dem a wok pan di striit lait fram mawnin.
translation: The men have been working on the street lights since morning.

sentence: Mi did api wen di lait kom bak, bikaa di pikni dem fried.
translation: I was relieved when the power came back, because the children were frightened.

sentence: Tek kier a yu granmada wen mi gaan a maakit, yaa.
translation: Look after your grandmother while I'm away at the market, all right?

sentence: Di dakta se mi fi tek kier a mi fut fi tuu wiik.
translation: The doctor said I should take care of my foot for two weeks.

sentence: Mi mada tek kier a evribadi, bot nobadi tek kier a im.
translation: My mother takes care of everybody, but nobody takes care of her.

sentence: Di rais no don kuk yet, suo sidong an wiet likl bit.
translation: The rice isn't done yet, so sit down and wait a little.

sentence: Mi sen di moni tuu wiik gaan, bot im no kaal mi yet.
translation: I sent the money two weeks ago, but he still hasn't called me.

sentence: Di pikni dem no riich fram skuul yet an mi a waari.
translation: The children aren't back from school yet and I'm starting to worry.

sentence: Evri iivnin mi elp mi bwai wid im matimatiks bifuo dina.
translation: Every evening I help my son with his maths before dinner.

sentence: Wi av wan big matimatiks tes neks wiik, suo nobadi a plie.
translation: We have a big maths test next week, so nobody is fooling around.

sentence: Mi neva laik matimatiks a skuul, bot nou it elp mi biznis.
translation: I never liked maths at school, but now it helps me run my business.

sentence: Evribadi ina di yaad se di nyuu biebi faava im granfaada.
translation: Everybody at the house says the new baby takes after his grandfather.

sentence: Di man we sel fish dong a maakit faava mi onkl bad.
translation: The man who sells fish down at the market looks just like my uncle.

sentence: Mi kyaan biliiv ou yu faava yu sista wen unu tuu a laaf.
translation: I can't believe how much you look like your sister when the two of you laugh.

sentence: Di pikni dem plie ina di ous an mash-op mi bes chier.
translation: The children were playing in the house and wrecked my best chair.

sentence: Di rien faal suo aad, it mash-op di ruod we go a kontri.
translation: The rain fell so hard that it destroyed the road that goes to the country.

sentence: Mi beks bad, bikaa smadi mash-op mi nyuu baisikl a di giet.
translation: I'm really angry, because somebody wrecked my new bicycle at the gate.

sentence: Wen mi kom fram wok, di pikni dem nyam-op aal di dina.
translation: When I got home from work, the children had eaten up all the dinner.

sentence: Wi kuk nof chikin fi di pati, bot di fren dem nyam-op evriting.
translation: We cooked plenty of chicken for the party, but our friends devoured the lot.

sentence: Mi kyaan biliiv se di guot nyam-op evri flowa we mi plaant yeside.
translation: I can't believe the goat ate up every flower I planted yesterday.

sentence: Evri maanin mi granmada griit di neba dem we pas di giet.
translation: Every morning my grandmother greets the neighbours who pass the gate.

sentence: Di tiicha mek wi griit im ina Patwa bifuo wi staat fi ried.
translation: The teacher makes us greet him in Patois before we start reading.

sentence: It rang fi waak pas yu eldas an no griit dem gud maanin.
translation: It's wrong to walk past your elders and not greet them good morning.

sentence: Ina mi granmada ous, respek fi di eldas kom bifuo evriting.
translation: In my grandmother's house, respect for the elders comes before everything.

sentence: Wen di uol fishaman pas, evri bwai a di sii gi im respek.
translation: When the old fisherman goes by, every boy at the shore shows him respect.

sentence: Mi no waan yu moni, mi onggl waan wan likl respek fram yu.
translation: I don't want your money, all I want is a little respect from you.

sentence: Mi mada bigop mi bifuo di huol famili wen mi pas di tes.
translation: My mother praised me in front of the whole family when I passed the exam.

sentence: Di singa bigop evri smadi we kom out a di dansaal las nait.
translation: The singer gave a shout-out to everyone who came out to the dancehall last night.

sentence: Mi hafi bigop mi tiicha, bikaa a shi mek mi lov fi ried.
translation: I have to big up my teacher, because she's the one who made me love reading.

sentence: Mek wi linkop a di shap afta yu don wash di kloz.
translation: Let's meet up at the shop after you've finished washing the clothes.

sentence: Mi wi linkop wid di oda faama dem a di maakit Satdi maanin.
translation: I'll meet up with the other farmers at the market on Saturday morning.

sentence: Mi api evri taim wi linkop, bikaa yu aalwiez mek mi laaf.
translation: I'm happy every time we get together, because you always make me laugh.

sentence: Evri Sondi afta chorch mi chek mi granmada op a di hil.
translation: Every Sunday after church I go and visit my grandmother up on the hill.

sentence: Bifuo yu jraiv go a toun, chek di wata ina di kyaar.
translation: Before you drive into town, check the water in the car.

sentence: It sad se nobadi neva chek pan di uol man neks duo.
translation: It's sad that nobody ever looks in on the old man next door.

sentence: Wi go a di sii waan-taim a mont, wen di kyaar a wok.
translation: We go down to the sea once a month, whenever the car is running.

sentence: Di faama tel wi fi pik aal di mango waan-taim, bifuo rien faal.
translation: The farmer told us to pick all the mangoes at once, before the rain came.

sentence: Mi si wan dopi waan-taim wen mi did likl, an mi stil fried.
translation: I saw a duppy once when I was small, and I'm still frightened.

sentence: Mi hafi bied di dag tuu-taim a mont, bikaa im lov di doti.
translation: I have to bathe the dog twice a month, because he loves the dirt.

sentence: Di bos pas mi tuu-taim dis maanin bikaa i did ful op.
translation: The bus passed me twice this morning because it was packed.

sentence: Mi aks yu tuu-taim aredi fi kaal mi, bot yu neva kaal bak.
translation: I've asked you twice already to call me, but you never called back.

sentence: Dis a di ous we mi granmada baan an grou op.
translation: This is the house where my grandmother was born and grew up.

sentence: Di faama tel mi se dis mango dem no riedi yet.
translation: The farmer told me these mangoes aren't ready yet.

sentence: Mi kyaan biliiv dis, di piipl dem stil a tan ina di rien.
translation: I can't believe this — the people are still standing out there in the rain.

sentence: Wa yu a du a yaad suo orli pan wan satdi mawnin?
translation: What are you doing at home so early on a Saturday morning?

sentence: Di dakta aks mi wa mi did a du wen mi fut brok.
translation: The doctor asked me what I was doing when I broke my foot.

sentence: Mi sari fi we mi du, bot mi kyaan ton bak nou.
translation: I'm sorry for what I did, but I can't turn back now.

sentence: Mi mada sen mi go elp di eldas dem kya dem bag.
translation: My mother sent me to help the elders carry their bags.

sentence: Di eldas fram di chorch kom a yaad fi taak tu mi faada.
translation: The elders from the church came to the house to talk to my father.

sentence: Di eldas dem wort muor dan gold, bot nobadi no lisn tu dem.
translation: The elders are worth more than gold, but nobody listens to them.

sentence: Mi granmada aalwiez se wanti wanti kyaan getti wen mi staat baal fi muor.
translation: My grandmother always says 'those who want can't get' whenever I start crying for more.

sentence: Im a beg mi fi di las mango, bot wanti wanti kyaan getti.
translation: He's begging me for the last mango, but those who want can't get.

sentence: Mi did waan di wok suo bad, bot wanti wanti kyaan getti.
translation: I wanted that job so badly, but those who want can't get.

sentence: Duon figet fi kaal mi wen yu riich a yaad, yaa.
translation: Don't forget to call me when you get home, you hear?

sentence: Di tiicha did kaal mi mada bikaa mi neva riich skuul pan taim.
translation: The teacher phoned my mother because I didn't get to school on time.

sentence: Im neva kaal mi bak fram las wiik, an dat mek mi beks.
translation: He hasn't called me back since last week, and that makes me angry.

sentence: Mi granmada taak Patwa tu mi fram mi did wan likl pikni.
translation: My grandmother has spoken Patois to me since I was a small child.

sentence: Mi a laan Patwa fi chuu, bikaa mi waan andastan di dansaal sang.
translation: I'm learning Patois for real, because I want to understand the dancehall songs.

sentence: Patwa swiit ina mi ier wen mi granfaada a tel im uol stori.
translation: Patois sounds sweet in my ear when my grandfather is telling his old stories.

sentence: Mi aanti sen dis bag a mango fram kontri fi di huol famili.
translation: My aunt sent this bag of mangoes from the country for the whole family.

sentence: Di fishaman dem kom bak fram sii wid nof fish dis mawnin.
translation: The fishermen came back from the sea with plenty of fish this morning.

sentence: Nobadi no nuo we di myuuzik a kom fram, bot evribadi a daans.
translation: Nobody knows where the music is coming from, but everybody is dancing.

sentence: Lisn tu mi gud nou: duon open di giet fi nobadi tide.
translation: Listen to me carefully now: don't open the gate for anybody today.

sentence: Mi neva se notn tu di polis wen dem aks mi bout di fait.
translation: I didn't say anything to the police when they asked me about the fight.

sentence: Mi neba nais tu mi, im aalwiez sen dina ova wen mi sik.
translation: My neighbour is good to me — she always sends dinner over when I'm sick.

sentence: Mi kyaan tingk strait dis mawnin, di pikni dem a baal fram siks aklak.
translation: I can't think straight this morning; the children have been bawling since six o'clock.

sentence: Mi did tingk se di miitn did don, bot piipl stil a taak.
translation: I thought the meeting was over, but people are still talking.

sentence: Mi laik ou yu tingk, yu aalwiez fain wan ansa we nobadi no si.
translation: I like the way you think — you always find an answer nobody else sees.

sentence: Mi naa nyam no mit tide, mi onggl waan som rais an piiz.
translation: I'm not eating any meat today, I just want some rice and peas.

sentence: Di bos naa ron pan sondi, suo wi hafi tek wan taksi.
translation: The bus isn't running on Sunday, so we have to take a taxi.

sentence: Mi naa taak tu im agen afta ou im tel lai pan mi.
translation: I'm not speaking to him again after the way he lied about me.

sentence: Bifuo wi nyam, mi granmada aalwiez tank Jah fi di fuud.
translation: Before we eat, my grandmother always gives thanks to Jah for the food.

sentence: Wen di lait gaan las nait, di eldas dem stil a sing tu Jah.
translation: When the power went out last night, the elders were still singing to Jah.

sentence: Mi neva biliiv mi wuda si dis die, bot Jah nuo bes.
translation: I never thought I'd live to see this day, but Jah knows best.

sentence: Mi aanti kuk wan big pat a ital fuud evri Satdi mawnin.
translation: My aunt cooks a big pot of ital food every Saturday morning.

sentence: Mi fren open wan ital shap a toun, an di yuut dem lov it.
translation: My friend opened an ital shop in town, and the young people love it.

sentence: Mi breda se ital fuud swiit, bot mi stil waan wan piis a chikin.
translation: My brother says ital food tastes good, but I still want a piece of chicken.

sentence: Mi onkl plaant ganja op a kontri, bot di rien mash-op evriting.
translation: My uncle planted ganja up in the country, but the rain destroyed the lot.

sentence: Wen tuuris kom a Jamieka, som a dem onggl aks bout rege an ganja.
translation: When tourists come to Jamaica, some of them only ask about reggae and ganja.

sentence: Mi mada beks bad wen shi smel ganja ina di bak yaad.
translation: My mother gets really angry when she smells ganja in the back yard.

sentence: Mi granmada se dopi de pan di ruod, so shi no waak a nait.
translation: My grandmother says there are duppies out on the road, so she doesn't walk at night.

sentence: Nobadi no waan bai di uol ous bikaa piipl se dopi liv de-so.
translation: Nobody wants to buy the old house because people say a duppy lives there.

sentence: Mi neva biliiv ina dopi til mi ier sinting a waak ina di ous.
translation: I never believed in duppies until I heard something walking about in the house.

sentence: Wen di biznis brok dong, im breda se a obiya dem wok pan im.
translation: When the business collapsed, his brother said it was obeah somebody had worked on him.

sentence: Di uol man dong a di riva tek moni fi wok obiya fi piipl.
translation: The old man down by the river takes money to work obeah for people.

sentence: Mi granfaada se obiya kyan ton bak pan di wan we sen it.
translation: My grandfather says obeah can turn back on the person who sent it.

sentence: Wen di lait gaan, mi mada tel wi Anansi stori ina di daak.
translation: When the power went out, my mother told us Anansi stories in the dark.

sentence: Duon lisn tu im, im a chrik yu jos laik Anansi chrik Taiga.
translation: Don't listen to him, he's tricking you just the way Anansi tricked Tiger.

sentence: Mi lov Anansi bikaa di likl spaida aalwiez beta dan di big animal dem.
translation: I love Anansi because the little spider always outsmarts the big animals.

sentence: Nof labrish a gwaan a di shap tide bout uu marid uu.
translation: There's plenty of gossip going round the shop today about who married whom.

sentence: Wen mi riich a wok, di labrish bout di nyuu manija did don staat.
translation: By the time I got to work, the gossip about the new manager had already started.

sentence: Mi taiyad a di labrish we gwaan a chorch bout mi kloz evri Sondi.
translation: I'm tired of the gossip that goes on at church about my clothes every Sunday.

sentence: Wen di son go dong, wi jos chil pan di veranda an drink ti.
translation: When the sun goes down, we just relax on the veranda and drink tea.

sentence: Kom chil wid wi dong a di riva Satdi, wi a kuk fish.
translation: Come and chill with us down by the river on Saturday, we're cooking fish.

sentence: Mi kyaan chil wen so moch wok de pan mi ed.
translation: I can't relax with so much work on my mind.

sentence: Wi hafi smaal-op roun di tiebl bikaa so moch famili kom fi Krismos.
translation: We had to squeeze up round the table because so much family came for Christmas.

sentence: Wen di chorch ful op pan Sondi, di pasta aks wi fi smaal-op.
translation: When the church fills up on Sunday, the pastor asks us to make room.

sentence: Mi taiyad fi smaal-op ina di taksi evri mawnin fi go a wok.
translation: I'm tired of squeezing up in the taxi every morning to get to work.

sentence: Wen mi kudn pie di huol fier, di taksi man gi mi wan blai.
translation: When I couldn't pay the whole fare, the taxi man let me off.

sentence: Di tiicha gi di bwai wan las blai bifuo shi sen im a yaad.
translation: The teacher gave the boy one last chance before she sent him home.

sentence: Mi neva get no blai fram nobadi wen mi did yong an brok.
translation: Nobody ever gave me a break when I was young and broke.

sentence: Di dag jomp ova di giet an ron dong di striit afta di taksi.
translation: The dog jumped over the gate and ran down the street after the taxi.

sentence: Kom ova a mi yaad satdi iivnin, wi a kuk dina fi evribadi.
translation: Come over to my yard on Saturday evening, we're cooking dinner for everybody.

sentence: Mi kyaan sliip wen di myuuzik fram di dansaal a kom ova di fens.
translation: I can't sleep when the music from the dancehall comes over the fence.

sentence: Evri maanin mi granmada mek ti an wiek evribadi ina di ous.
translation: Every morning my grandmother makes tea and wakes everybody in the house.

sentence: Wi did a labrish a di giet aal maanin an figet fi kuk dina.
translation: We were gossiping at the gate all morning and forgot to cook dinner.

sentence: Ina di maanin mi kyaan taak tu nobadi bifuo mi drink mi kaafi.
translation: In the morning I can't talk to anybody before I've had my coffee.

sentence: Kuul dong, man, di bos ago kom suun an wi no liet yet.
translation: Calm down, man, the bus is going to come soon and we're not late yet.

sentence: Di polis tel di tuu man fi kuul dong bifuo di fait staat.
translation: The policeman told the two men to calm down before the fight started.

sentence: Wen mi beks bad, mi waak go a di sii fi kuul dong.
translation: When I get really angry, I walk down to the sea to cool off.

sentence: Mi mada sen mi go a di shap fi saal an wan dazn eg.
translation: My mother sent me to the shop for salt and a dozen eggs.

sentence: Evri wiik mi onkl sen moni kom fi bai buk fi di pikni dem.
translation: Every week my uncle sends money over to buy books for the children.

sentence: Mi beks se dem neva sen no ansa afta mi rait chrii taim.
translation: I'm annoyed that they never sent any answer after I wrote three times.

sentence: Evri maanin di jankro dem a flai ova di bush a luk fi fuud.
translation: Every morning the john crows are flying over the bush looking for food.

sentence: Wan waas flai kom ina di ruum an mek di pikni dem baal out.
translation: A wasp flew into the room and made the children scream.

sentence: Mi aanti fried fi flai, suo im neva lef Jamieka wan die yet.
translation: My aunt is afraid to fly, so she has never left Jamaica for a single day.

sentence: Dis uol baisikl wort muor dan di nyuu wan we dem a sel.
translation: This old bicycle is worth more than the new one they're selling.

sentence: Di faama se im guot wort chrii touzn dala a maakit tide.
translation: The farmer says his goat is worth three thousand dollars at the market today.

sentence: Mi granfaada aalwiez se wan gud fren wort muor dan nof moni.
translation: My grandfather always says one good friend is worth more than plenty of money.

sentence: Mi mada gruo pepa, koko an banana baka di ous.
translation: My mother grows peppers, coco and bananas behind the house.

sentence: Di tiicha mek di pikni dem gruo piiz ina wan glaas a wata.
translation: The teacher had the children grow peas in a glass of water.

sentence: Luk ou fas di biebi gruo, im aredi big laik im breda.
translation: Look how fast the baby is growing, he's already as big as his brother.

sentence: Di dag dem staat baak ina di nait an fraitn di huol famili.
translation: The dogs started barking in the night and frightened the whole family.

sentence: Di nyuu tiicha no waan fraitn di likl wan dem pan dem fos die.
translation: The new teacher doesn't want to frighten the little ones on their first day.

sentence: Mi granmada stori bout dopi fraitn mi bad, suo mi no waak a nait.
translation: My grandmother's ghost stories scared me so badly that I don't walk out at night.
