sentence: Mi likl breda taala dan mi nou, an im onggl ten.
translation: My little brother is taller than me now, and he's only ten.

sentence: Dem mek di taala bwai dem tan a di bak fi di skuul pikcha.
translation: They made the taller boys stand at the back for the school photo.

sentence: Evribadi se mi taala dan mi faada, bot mi no biliiv dem.
translation: Everybody says I'm taller than my father, but I don't believe them.

sentence: Mi kot mi finga wen mi did a kliin di fish fi dina.
translation: I cut my finger while I was cleaning the fish for dinner.

sentence: Di nors aks di uol man fi muuv aal ten finga slou-slou.
translation: The nurse asked the old man to move all ten fingers very slowly.

sentence: Mi kyaan biliiv se im plie di huol sang wid onggl fuor finga.
translation: I can't believe he played the whole song with only four fingers.

sentence: Mi mada put di big pat pan di faiya bifuo di rien staat.
translation: My mother put the big pot on the fire before the rain started.

sentence: Di uman dem a kuk di rais ina wan big pat fi di pati.
translation: The women are cooking the rice in a big pot for the party.

sentence: Mi no laik wash di pat afta Sondi dina, bot mi hafi du it.
translation: I don't like washing the pot after Sunday dinner, but I have to.

sentence: Di pikni dem waan si di shuo pan di fuon bifuo dem sliip.
translation: The children want to watch the show on the phone before they go to sleep.

sentence: Di shuo a go staat nain aklak, suo mek wi lef di yaad nou.
translation: The show is going to start at nine o'clock, so let's leave the yard now.

sentence: Di shuo las nait swiit mi suo, mi neva waan go a mi yaad.
translation: Last night's show was so good that I didn't want to go home.

sentence: Di daag sliip anda di ous di huol die wen di son at.
translation: The dog sleeps under the house all day when the sun is hot.

sentence: Mi neba daag dem a baak evri taim smadi pas di giet.
translation: My neighbour's dogs bark every time somebody passes the gate.

sentence: Mi lov mi daag muor dan som a di piipl we mi nuo.
translation: I love my dog more than some of the people I know.

sentence: Di tes tumaro aad, bot mi ried di huol buk aredi.
translation: Tomorrow's test is hard, but I've already read the whole book.

sentence: Wok a di maakit aad wen rien a faal an nobadi no kom.
translation: Working at the market is hard when the rain is falling and nobody comes.

sentence: It aad fi figet wan fren we yu gruo op wid.
translation: It's hard to forget a friend you grew up with.

sentence: Mi neva miin fi brok di glaas, suo no beks wid mi.
translation: I didn't mean to break the glass, so don't be upset with me.

sentence: Wen di tiicha se 'suun kom', im miin se im a go tek taim.
translation: When the teacher says 'soon come', he means he's going to take his time.

sentence: Mi no nuo wa yu miin wen yu tel mi se yu aarait.
translation: I don't know what you mean when you tell me you're fine.

sentence: Wi neva kuk no mit, suo wi nyam soso rais fi dina.
translation: We didn't cook any meat, so we ate nothing but plain rice for dinner.

sentence: Soso man de a di miitn, an dem no waan lisn tu mi.
translation: It's nothing but men at the meeting, and they don't want to listen to me.

sentence: Yu a taak soso lai, an evribadi ina di yaad nuo it.
translation: You're talking nothing but lies, and everybody in the yard knows it.

sentence: Afta skuul di pikni dem plie futbaal ina di striit wid wan uol baal.
translation: After school the children play football in the street with an old ball.

sentence: Evri Satdi mi onkl an im fren dem plie futbaal a di skuul yaad.
translation: Every Saturday my uncle and his friends play football in the school yard.

sentence: Wen Jamieka win di futbaal, di huol toun staat daans an sing.
translation: When Jamaica wins at football, the whole town starts dancing and singing.

sentence: Mi mada wok haad aal die an stil kuk dina fi wi.
translation: My mother works hard all day and still cooks dinner for us.

sentence: Di faama dem wok haad fram mawnin tu nait fi mek wan likl moni.
translation: The farmers work hard from morning till night to make a little money.

sentence: Mi chrai haad fi andastan di buk, bot mi tuu taiyad tide.
translation: I'm trying hard to understand the book, but I'm too tired today.

sentence: Di daag dem a baak fram mawnin bikaa di pus de pan di fens.
translation: The dogs have been barking since morning because the cat is on the fence.

sentence: Wen di daag dem baak, di faama nuo se smadi de a di giet.
translation: When the dogs bark, the farmer knows somebody is at the gate.

sentence: Di daag baak hai aal nait, suo nobadi ina di ous kudn sliip.
translation: The dog barked loudly all night, so nobody in the house could sleep.

sentence: Afta di rien faal fi chrii die, di ruod bikom wan riva.
translation: After the rain fell for three days, the road became a river.

sentence: Mi breda staat sel fish a di maakit an bikom wan biznis man.
translation: My brother started selling fish at the market and became a businessman.

sentence: Di likl bwai we yu memba bikom wan big man aredi.
translation: The little boy you remember has already become a grown man.

sentence: Evri Sondi maanin mi granmada mek mi sing ina di kwaia a chorch.
translation: Every Sunday morning my grandmother makes me sing in the choir at church.

sentence: Las nait di kwaia praktis chruu di rien fi di konsert a Satdi.
translation: Last night the choir rehearsed right through the rain for Saturday's concert.

sentence: Mi kyaan stap krai wen di kwaia sing di sang mi mada did lov.
translation: I can't stop crying when the choir sings the song my mother loved.

sentence: Evri Krismos mi mada tel wi di stori bout di chrii king dem.
translation: Every Christmas my mother tells us the story about the three kings.

sentence: Fi di skuul plie, dem mek Delroy di king an gi im wan kroun.
translation: For the school play, they made Delroy the king and gave him a crown.

sentence: Afta im win di daans, im waak chruu di dansaal laik im a king.
translation: After he won the dance contest, he walked through the dancehall like a king.

sentence: Mi granmada put aal di mango dem ina wan big baskit.
translation: My grandmother put all the mangoes into one big basket.

sentence: Di uman a maakit a sel piiz outa wan baskit pan ar ed.
translation: The woman at the market is selling peas out of a basket balanced on her head.

sentence: Mi did beks wen di baskit brok an aal di eg dem mash op.
translation: I was furious when the basket broke and all the eggs got smashed.

sentence: Di daag jomp ova di fens agen an ron dong di ruod.
translation: The dog jumped over the fence again and ran off down the road.

sentence: Mi faada an mi onkl a fiks di fens bifuo di rien kom.
translation: My father and my uncle are mending the fence before the rain comes.

sentence: Mi neba put im fens pan mi lain, an dat beks mi bad.
translation: My neighbour put his fence right on my boundary line, and that made me really angry.

sentence: Di bos lef a siks aklak evri mawnin, so no kom liet.
translation: The bus leaves at six o'clock every morning, so don't turn up late.

sentence: Mi hafi riich a wok a sevn aklak, bot di taksi neva kom.
translation: I have to be at work by seven o'clock, but the taxi never showed up.

sentence: Di miitn ron til ten aklak, an evribadi did taiyad an ongri.
translation: The meeting dragged on until ten o'clock, and everybody was tired and hungry.

sentence: Evri Sondi mawnin mi granmada kuk rais an piiz fi di huol famili.
translation: Every Sunday morning my grandmother cooks rice and peas for the whole family.

sentence: Wi go a chorch pan Sondi, den wi waak go a di bich afta.
translation: We go to church on Sunday, then afterwards we walk down to the beach.

sentence: Mi no laik wen Sondi don, bikaa Mondi mawnin kom tuu kwik.
translation: I hate it when Sunday is over, because Monday morning comes around far too fast.

sentence: Gi mi wan glaas a kuol wata, di son at tuu bad tide.
translation: Give me a glass of cold water, the sun is far too hot today.

sentence: Afta wi don wok, evribadi sidong an drink wan glaas a juus.
translation: After we finished working, everybody sat down and drank a glass of juice.

sentence: Mi did fraitn wen di glaas faal an brok op ina di sink.
translation: I got a fright when the glass fell and smashed to pieces in the sink.

sentence: Mi mada kip wan uol pikcha a ar faada bai ar bed.
translation: My mother keeps an old photo of her father beside her bed.

sentence: Mek mi si di pikcha we yu tek a di pati laas nait.
translation: Let me see the photo you took at the party last night.

sentence: Evri taim mi luk pan dis pikcha, mi memba mi granmada an krai.
translation: Every time I look at this photo, I remember my grandmother and cry.

sentence: Di uol man dem did meri an a laaf til di pati don.
translation: The old men were in high spirits and kept laughing until the party ended.

sentence: Wen Krismus riich, di huol yaad meri an di myuuzik plie til mawnin.
translation: When Christmas comes around, the whole yard is merry and the music plays till morning.

sentence: Im luk meri pan di outsaid, bot mi nuo se im aat brok.
translation: He looks cheerful on the outside, but I know his heart is broken.

sentence: Wan haak a flai ova di yaad, a luk fi di chikin dem.
translation: A hawk is circling over the yard, hunting for the chickens.

sentence: Di faama shuo mi we di haak kech im bes fowl laas wiik.
translation: The farmer showed me where the hawk snatched his best hen last week.

sentence: Mi granmada aalwiez se, chikin meri, haak de nier, an im rait.
translation: My grandmother always says the chicken is merry while the hawk is near, and she's right.

sentence: Mi kaal fram di giet, bot nobadi ina di ous ier mi.
translation: I called from the gate, but nobody in the house heard me.

sentence: Evri iivnin mi granfaada lien pan di giet an labrish wid di neba.
translation: Every evening my grandfather leans on the gate and chats with the neighbour.

sentence: Mi taiyad fi tel di pikni dem fi kip di giet shet a nait.
translation: I'm tired of telling the children to keep the gate shut at night.

sentence: Mi mada bwail koko an yam fi dina wen di rien a faal.
translation: My mother boils cocoyam and yam for dinner when the rain is falling.

sentence: Di faama dig op im koko fram di grong bifuo di maakit open.
translation: The farmer digs his cocoyam out of the ground before the market opens.

sentence: Wan wan koko ful baskit, so tek yu taim an no gi op.
translation: One cocoyam at a time fills the basket, so take your time and don't give up.

sentence: Evri Sondi mi granmada kuk dina fi di huol famili.
translation: Every Sunday my grandmother cooks dinner for the whole family.

sentence: Mi riich a yaad liet fi dina bikaa di bos brok dong.
translation: I got home late for dinner because the bus broke down.

sentence: Di dina we dem sel a di nyuu shap no wort di moni.
translation: The dinner they sell at the new shop isn't worth the money.

sentence: Rien a faal fram maanin, suo nobadi no go a maakit tide.
translation: It has been raining since morning, so nobody went to the market today.

sentence: Wan mango faal pan di kyaar wen wi did a pas anda di tri.
translation: A mango fell on the car as we were passing under the tree.

sentence: Wen mi granfaada faal ina di yaad, evribadi ron kom elp im op.
translation: When my grandfather fell in the yard, everybody ran to help him up.

sentence: Wen mi did a pik mango, wan waas sting mi pan mi finga.
translation: While I was picking mangoes, a wasp stung me on the finger.

sentence: Evri taim mi nyam dat pepa, it sting mi mout an mek mi krai.
translation: Every time I eat that pepper it burns my mouth and makes me cry.

sentence: Di sii wata sting di kot pan mi fut, bot mi stil go swim.
translation: The sea water stung the cut on my foot, but I went swimming anyway.

sentence: Mi breda lef im baal ina di yaad an di dag kya it gaan.
translation: My brother left his ball in the yard and the dog carried it off.

sentence: Afta skuul di bwai dem plie futbaal wid wan uol baal pan di ruod.
translation: After school the boys play football with an old ball out in the road.

sentence: Mi neva kech di baal, an di huol skuul laaf afta mi.
translation: I missed the ball, and the whole school laughed at me.

sentence: Mi mada ful op di baskit wid mango an akii fi di maakit.
translation: My mother filled the basket with mangoes and ackee for the market.

sentence: Di chorch did ful fram maanin, suo wi hafi sidong a di bak.
translation: The church was full from early morning, so we had to sit at the back.

sentence: Mi beli suo ful afta di Sondi dina dat mi kyaan muuv.
translation: My belly is so full after Sunday dinner that I can't move.

sentence: Yu did tel mi se yu a kom a di pati tumaro, iihn?
translation: You told me you were coming to the party tomorrow, right?

sentence: Yu shet di giet bifuo yu lef di ous dis maanin, iihn?
translation: You shut the gate before you left the house this morning, didn't you?

sentence: Dat rege sang we dem plie las nait swiit tuu bad, iihn?
translation: That reggae tune they played last night was really something, wasn't it?

sentence: Duon open di duo fi nobadi wen mi gaan a maakit, yu ier mi?
translation: Don't open the door for anybody while I'm at the market, you hear me?

sentence: Duon lef di giet open, di guot dem wi kom nyam mi plaant.
translation: Don't leave the gate open, the goats will come and eat my plants.

sentence: Duon waari bout wa piipl a se, yu du yu bes aredi.
translation: Don't worry about what people are saying, you already did your best.

sentence: Di pus a sliip baka di duo we nobadi kyan si im.
translation: The cat is sleeping behind the door where nobody can see it.

sentence: Di faama put im guot dem baka di ous suo nobadi no tiif dem.
translation: The farmer keeps his goats behind the house so nobody steals them.

sentence: Mi lef mi baisikl baka di shap an wen mi kom bak it gaan.
translation: I left my bicycle behind the shop, and when I came back it was gone.

sentence: Mi no waan dat wan, gi mi di big mango pan di tiebl.
translation: I don't want that one, give me the big mango on the table.

sentence: Di tiicha aks uu du dat, bot nobadi ina di ruum no ansa.
translation: The teacher asked who did that, but nobody in the room answered.

sentence: Dat a di bes fuud mi nyam fram mi lef Jamieka.
translation: That is the best food I have eaten since I left Jamaica.

sentence: Mi kuk siks eg fi di pikni dem bifuo dem go a skuul.
translation: I cooked six eggs for the children before they went to school.

sentence: Di uman a di maakit sel mi wan dazn eg fi chrii onjred dala.
translation: The woman at the market sold me a dozen eggs for three hundred dollars.

sentence: Mi bag brok an chrii eg faal dong pan di striit, mi did beks.
translation: My bag tore and three eggs fell into the street; I was furious.

sentence: Mi mada se mi fi go a di skuul miitn tumaro mawnin.
translation: My mother says I have to go to the school meeting tomorrow morning.

sentence: Di baas kaal wan miitn bikaa nobadi neva finish dem wok.
translation: The boss called a meeting because nobody had finished their work.

sentence: Mi taiyad fi si di siem miitn evri wiik an notn no chienj.
translation: I'm tired of sitting through the same meeting every week and nothing ever changes.

sentence: Mi granmada mek mi raiz di rejista wen di paasn kom a wi yaad.
translation: My grandmother makes me raise my register when the pastor comes to our house.

sentence: Wen mi go a di jab intavyuu, mi swich di rejista tu Ingglish.
translation: When I went to the job interview, I switched my register over to English.

sentence: Som piipl tingk di lou rejista fuulish, bot a suo wi taak evri die.
translation: Some people think the low register is foolish, but that's how we talk every day.

sentence: Mi granmada kuk wan huol pat a rais an piiz fi Sondi dina.
translation: My grandmother cooked a whole pot of rice and peas for Sunday dinner.

sentence: Mi wok ina di son wan huol die an mi bak a kil mi.
translation: I worked in the sun a whole day and now my back is killing me.

sentence: Huol dis bag fi mi wen mi a pie di taksi man.
translation: Hold this bag for me while I pay the taxi driver.

sentence: Di biebi krai aal nait, bot di dakta se im aarait.
translation: The baby cried all night, but the doctor says he's fine.

sentence: Yu aarait? Yu luk laik yu waak fram toun ina di son.
translation: Are you alright? You look like you walked all the way from town in the sun.

sentence: Mi did fraitn fi di eksam, bot mi aarait afta di fos kwestyan.
translation: I was scared of the exam, but I was fine after the first question.

sentence: Mi mada lak di giet a nain aklak, so duon kom yaad liet.
translation: My mother locks the gate at nine o'clock, so don't come home late.

sentence: Di bos brok dong pan di ruod, so mi riich wok liet agen.
translation: The bus broke down on the road, so I got to work late again.

sentence: Mi no laik riich a pati liet, bikaa aal di fuud don aredi.
translation: I don't like getting to a party late, because all the food is finished already.

sentence: Mi likl breda win di ries a skuul an im kyaan stap taak.
translation: My little brother won the race at school and he can't stop talking about it.

sentence: Ef wi win di mach pan Satdi, wi a go daans ina di striit.
translation: If we win the match on Saturday, we're going to be dancing in the street.

sentence: Im win di lotri las iiya an im no memba im fren dem.
translation: He won the lottery last year and now he doesn't remember his friends.

sentence: Mi granfaada gedop orli evri mawnin fi fiid di fowl dem.
translation: My grandfather gets up early every morning to feed the chickens.

sentence: Kom a di maakit orli ef yu waan di bes mango.
translation: Come to the market early if you want the best mangoes.

sentence: Mi glad se mi lef di ous orli, bikaa di chrafik bad afta faiv.
translation: I'm glad I left the house early, because the traffic is bad after five.

sentence: Ton dong di faiya anda di pat bifuo di rais bon.
translation: Turn down the fire under the pot before the rice burns.

sentence: Ton lef a di chorch, den yu wi si mi ous pan di kaana.
translation: Turn left at the church, then you'll see my house on the corner.

sentence: Di likl bwai ton big man aredi, mi kyaan biliiv i.
translation: That little boy has turned into a grown man already, I can't believe it.

sentence: Di mango pan di tri a mi yaad swiit-swiit dis iiya.
translation: The mangoes on the tree in my yard are really sweet this year.

sentence: Di kiek we mi aanti biek fi di pati swiit, evribadi aks fi muor.
translation: The cake my aunt baked for the party was delicious, everybody asked for more.

sentence: Di dansaal myuuzik did suo swiit dat mi daans aal nait.
translation: The dancehall music was so sweet that I danced all night long.

sentence: No figet fi lak di giet wen yu gaan a shap, yaa.
translation: Don't forget to lock the gate when you go off to the shop, you hear?

sentence: Mi a lef nou, bot mi wi kaal yu wen mi riich yaad, yaa.
translation: I'm leaving now, but I'll call you when I get home, alright?

sentence: Duon waari bout mi, mi wi kom si yu pan Sondi, yaa.
translation: Don't worry about me, I'll come and see you on Sunday, you hear?

sentence: Nobadi no nuo wa hapn tu di fowl dem las nait.
translation: Nobody knows what happened to the chickens last night.

sentence: Wa hapn a di miitn yeside mek evribadi beks tide.
translation: What happened at the meeting yesterday has everybody angry today.

sentence: Notn no hapn tu im yet, bot mi stil a waari evri nait.
translation: Nothing has happened to him yet, but I still worry every night.

sentence: Mi granmada aalwiez tel mi fi sidong strait a di tiebl.
translation: My grandmother always tells me to sit up straight at the table.

sentence: Bifuo di konsert staat, di kwaia tan op strait an sing.
translation: Before the concert starts, the choir stands up straight and sings.

sentence: Aldo im uol, mi granfaada stil waak strait wid im ed op.
translation: Old as he is, my grandfather still walks straight with his head up.

sentence: Di dina riedi, bot di pikni dem stil a plie a di yaad.
translation: Dinner is ready, but the children are still playing in the yard.

sentence: Wi hafi riedi a siks aklak, di bos naa stap fi nobadi.
translation: We have to be ready at six o'clock — the bus won't stop for anybody.

sentence: Mi no riedi fi di tes, mi buk dem stil ina mi bag.
translation: I'm not ready for the test; my books are still in my bag.

sentence: Kom kwik, di rien a faal an di kloz dem pan di lain!
translation: Come quick, it's raining and the clothes are still on the line!

sentence: Di dakta si mi kwik bikaa di nors did nuo mi granmada.
translation: The doctor saw me quickly because the nurse knew my grandmother.

sentence: Mi laik ou kwik im ansa evri kwestyan we di tiicha aks.
translation: I like how quickly he answers every question the teacher asks.

sentence: Di huol ous smel gud wen mi mada a kuk di akii an saalfish.
translation: The whole house smells good when my mother is cooking the ackee and saltfish.

sentence: Di fish we dem a sel a di maakit smel bad ina di son.
translation: The fish they're selling at the market smells bad in the sun.

sentence: Evri taim mi smel mango, mi memba mi granfaada yaad a kontri.
translation: Every time I smell mango, I remember my grandfather's yard in the country.

sentence: Umoch di banana dem kaas a di maakit dis wiik?
translation: How much do the bananas cost at the market this week?

sentence: Di nyuu fuon kaas chrii touzn dala, suo mi lef it a di shap.
translation: The new phone costs three thousand dollars, so I left it in the shop.

sentence: Di taksi kaas muor dan di bos, bot mi tek it ina di rien.
translation: The taxi costs more than the bus, but I take it when it's raining.

sentence: Mi mada se mi kyaan go a di dansaal bifuo di tes don.
translation: My mother says I can't go to the dancehall until the test is over.

sentence: Di tiicha gi wi wan aad tes an onggl chrii pikni pas it.
translation: The teacher gave us a hard test and only three children passed it.

sentence: Mi waari huol nait bout di tes, bot di tiicha se mi du wel.
translation: I worried all night about the test, but the teacher said I did well.

sentence: Evri satdi mawnin mi granmada sen mi go a di maakit fi fish.
translation: Every Saturday morning my grandmother sends me to the market for fish.

sentence: Wi plie futbaal a di skuul yaad evri satdi iivnin.
translation: We play football in the schoolyard every Saturday evening.

sentence: Satdi nait a di onggl taim di huol famili sidong an iit.
translation: Saturday night is the only time the whole family sits down and eats.

sentence: Pas mi di saal, mi kyaan riich it fram ova ya.
translation: Pass me the salt — I can't reach it from over here.

sentence: Di bos pas di giet bifuo mi riich, suo mi hafi waak a toun.
translation: The bus passed the gate before I got there, so I had to walk to town.

sentence: Mi neva tink mi wuda pas di tes, bot mi mada did nuo.
translation: I never thought I would pass the test, but my mother knew I would.

sentence: Di bes mango dem de hai pan di tri, an mi kyaan riich dem.
translation: The best mangoes are up high on the tree, and I can't reach them.

sentence: Di faama put di baskit hai suo di guot dem kyaan riich di frut.
translation: The farmer puts the basket up high so the goats can't reach the fruit.

sentence: Wen di kwaia sing hai, evribadi ina di chorch tan op.
translation: When the choir sings high, everybody in the church stands up.

sentence: Di lain a di bank did so lang dat mi neva bada wiet.
translation: The queue at the bank was so long that I didn't even bother to wait.

sentence: Wi a tan op ina di taksi lain from siks aklak dis mawnin.
translation: We've been standing in the taxi queue since six o'clock this morning.

sentence: Nobadi no laik di lain a di klinik, bot evribadi hafi wiet dem ton.
translation: Nobody likes the queue at the clinic, but everyone has to wait their turn.

sentence: Smadi a nak a di duo from mawnin an nobadi no ansa yet.
translation: Somebody has been knocking at the door since morning and nobody has answered yet.

sentence: Nak pan di giet wen yu riich, bikaa di daag dem de a yaad.
translation: Knock on the gate when you get here, because the dogs are in the yard.

sentence: Mi nak mi fut pan di tiebl an mi kudn waak chrii die.
translation: I banged my foot on the table and couldn't walk for three days.

sentence: Akii a di nashanal frut, an mi mada kuk it evri Sondi mawnin.
translation: Ackee is the national fruit, and my mother cooks it every Sunday morning.

sentence: Di huol toun shet dong wen di nashanal tiim a plie a di stiedyam.
translation: The whole town shuts down when the national team plays at the stadium.

sentence: Mi granmada aalwiez krai wen shi ier di nashanal antem pan Indipendans Die.
translation: My grandmother always cries when she hears the national anthem on Independence Day.

sentence: Mi granfaada plaant chrii mango tri a di bak a di yaad.
translation: My grandfather planted three mango trees at the back of the yard.

sentence: Di faama dem a plaant yam bifuo di rien staat fi faal ina Mie.
translation: The farmers are planting yam before the rains start falling in May.

sentence: Afta di harikien mash op evriting, wi plaant bak di huol gyaadn tugeda.
translation: After the hurricane wrecked everything, we replanted the whole garden together.

sentence: Mi likl sista a sing a di skuul konsert an di famili a go.
translation: My little sister is singing at the school concert and the family is going.

sentence: Di rege konsert a di biich neva don til fuor aklak ina di mawnin.
translation: The reggae concert on the beach didn't finish until four in the morning.

sentence: Mi did waan go a di konsert bot di tikit dem tuu dier.
translation: I wanted to go to the concert but the tickets were too expensive.

sentence: Len mi yu ombrela til tumaro, bikaa rien a go faal dis iivnin.
translation: Lend me your umbrella until tomorrow, because it's going to rain this evening.

sentence: Mi neba len mi im laada fi fiks di ruuf afta di stuorm.
translation: My neighbour lent me his ladder to fix the roof after the storm.

sentence: Duon len im no moni agen, bikaa im neva pie bak di las wan.
translation: Don't lend him any more money, because he never paid back the last lot.

sentence: Wi a muuv go a wan nyuu ous a Puotmuor bifuo skuul staat bak.
translation: We're moving to a new house in Portmore before school starts again.

sentence: Muuv di tiebl dem outa di wie so di dansaal kyan staat.
translation: Move the tables out of the way so the dance can start.

sentence: Di bos neva muuv fi twenti minit, an evribadi ina it staat beks.
translation: The bus didn't move for twenty minutes, and everyone on it got annoyed.

sentence: Di juus we mi mek natral, bikaa mi no put no shuga ina it.
translation: The juice I make is natural, because I don't put any sugar in it.

sentence: Di bwai av wan natral taalent fi futbaal, an nobadi neva tiich im.
translation: The boy has a natural talent for football, and nobody ever taught him.

sentence: It natral fi fiil fried di fos taim yu tan op bifuo piipl.
translation: It's natural to feel scared the first time you stand up in front of people.

sentence: Di bak a di yaad ton ina wan jongl afta chrii wiik a rien.
translation: The back of the yard turned into a jungle after three weeks of rain.

sentence: Di gaid tek wi go ina di jongl fi si di uol Maruun vilij.
translation: The guide took us into the jungle to see the old Maroon village.

sentence: Toun kyan fiil laik wan jongl wen yu fos kom fram kontri.
translation: Town can feel like a jungle when you first come from the country.

sentence: Big blak kloud a gyada ova di ils, so tek in di kloz kwik.
translation: Big black clouds are gathering over the hills, so bring the clothes in quickly.

sentence: Di fishaman dem no go a sii tide bikaa di kloud dem luk dak.
translation: The fishermen aren't going out to sea today because the clouds look dark.

sentence: Wi lidong pan di graas an wach di kloud dem muuv slou ova wi.
translation: We lay on the grass and watched the clouds drift slowly over us.

sentence: Evri mawnin mi granmada mek ti bifuo di son kom op.
translation: Every morning my grandmother makes tea before the sun comes up.

sentence: Mi hafi elp mi aanti sel frut a maakit evri Satdi mawnin.
translation: I have to help my aunt sell fruit at the market every Saturday morning.

sentence: Evri taim mi ier dat sang, mi memba mi granmada an mi waan krai.
translation: Every time I hear that song, I remember my grandmother and I want to cry.

sentence: Afta Sondi dina, a mi ton fi wash di pliet dem.
translation: After Sunday dinner, it's my turn to wash the plates.

sentence: Afta chorch, dem shier out wan pliet a fuud gi evri smadi.
translation: After church, they share out a plate of food for everybody.

sentence: Mi kyaan iit no muor — di pliet did tuu ful fi mi.
translation: I can't eat any more — the plate was too full for me.

sentence: No waari bout di dina, mi aredi kuk rais an piiz fi wi.
translation: Don't worry about dinner, I've already cooked rice and peas for us.

sentence: Aal di neba dem a labrish bout di nyuu shap dong a di striit.
translation: All the neighbours are gossiping about the new shop down the street.

sentence: Mi kyaan stap tink bout wa di dakta se tu mi faada yeside.
translation: I can't stop thinking about what the doctor said to my father yesterday.

sentence: Wen di chail did sik, mi kya im go a di klinik orli mawnin.
translation: When the child was sick, I took him to the clinic early in the morning.

sentence: Di tiicha se evri chail mos bring wan pen kom a skuul tumaro.
translation: The teacher said every child must bring a pen to school tomorrow.

sentence: Mi kyaan taak nou, mi bizi a kuk dina fi di pikni dem.
translation: I can't talk now, I'm busy cooking dinner for the children.

sentence: Di striit bizi wid piipl a bai fuud bifuo di rien staat faal.
translation: The street is busy with people buying food before the rain starts falling.

sentence: Mi taiyad fi ier se yu bizi — yu neva kaal mi aal wiik.
translation: I'm tired of hearing that you're busy — you didn't call me all week.

sentence: Smadi tek di kii aaf di tiebl an nou mi kyaan open di giet.
translation: Somebody took the key off the table and now I can't open the gate.

sentence: Mi lef di kii dem wid mi neba til mi kom bak fram farin.
translation: I left the keys with my neighbour until I come back from abroad.

sentence: Mi beks wid miself — mi lak di kii dem ina di kyaar agen.
translation: I'm vexed with myself — I locked the keys in the car again.

sentence: Evri mawnin di eldas waak go a di bush fi im Iditation.
translation: Every morning the elder walks up into the bush for his meditation.

sentence: Afta di drum dem stap, I-an-I sidong ina wan lang Iditation.
translation: After the drums stopped, we sat down in a long meditation.

sentence: Wen di dansaal tuu loud, Iditation a di onggl ting we kaam I-an-I.
translation: When the dancehall is too loud, meditation is the only thing that calms me.

sentence: Mi granmada kuk wan big pat a suup evri Satdi fi di huol wiik.
translation: My grandmother cooks a big pot of soup every Saturday for the whole week.

sentence: Mi wok siks die a di wiik an res onggl pan Sondi.
translation: I work six days of the week and only rest on Sunday.

sentence: Di wiik did lang bad, an wen Fraide riich mi onggl waan sliip.
translation: The week was really long, and when Friday came all I wanted was sleep.

sentence: Sidong an res yu fut, yu waak fram maakit ina di son.
translation: Sit down and rest your feet — you walked all the way from the market in the sun.

sentence: Di faama res anda di mango tri wen di son tuu haad.
translation: The farmer rests under the mango tree when the sun is too harsh.

sentence: Mi kyaan res til mi ier se di pikni dem riich a yaad sief.
translation: I can't rest until I hear that the children got home safe.

sentence: Di bos brok dong, suo wi neva riich a toun til afta daak.
translation: The bus broke down, so we didn't get to town until after dark.

sentence: Wen di boks fram farin riich, di huol famili kom roun fi si.
translation: When the box from abroad arrived, the whole family came round to see.

sentence: Wen wi riich a di konsert, di bes ban aredi don plie.
translation: When we got to the concert, the best band had already played.
